import type { Ref } from 'vue';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { mountTableList } from '../templates/search/table-list/mount.js';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(
	element: Element,
	onError: (error: unknown) => void,
	i18n?: AsamI18n,
	options?: { fullWidth?: Ref<boolean> }
) {
	const result = await mountTableList(
		element,
		{ i18n, inheritAppearance: true, ...options },
		onError
	);
	return result;
}

import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type {} from './i18n/Parameters.js';
import type { AsamListContent } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { SearchRecord } from './Types.js';

export function displayValue(value: unknown, scope?: AsamI18n): string {
	return value === undefined
		? scope?.enabled.value
			? scope.t('app.templates.search.notProvided')
			: '未提供'
		: value === null
			? scope?.enabled.value
				? scope.t('app.templates.search.unknown')
				: '未知'
			: value === false
				? scope?.enabled.value
					? scope.t('app.templates.search.no')
					: '否'
				: value === true
					? scope?.enabled.value
						? scope.t('app.templates.search.yes')
						: '是'
					: String(value);
}
export function displayDate(value: string | null | undefined, scope?: AsamI18n): string {
	if (value === undefined || value === null) return displayValue(value, scope);
	return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value) &&
		Number.isFinite(Date.parse(value)) &&
		new Date(value).toISOString().slice(0, 10) === value
		? scope?.enabled.value
			? new Intl.DateTimeFormat(scope.locale.value, {
					year: 'numeric',
					month: '2-digit',
					day: '2-digit',
					timeZone: 'UTC'
				}).format(new Date(value))
			: value
		: scope?.enabled.value
			? scope.t('app.templates.search.invalidDate')
			: '日期无效';
}
export function displayProgress(value: number | null | undefined, scope?: AsamI18n): string {
	return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 && value <= 100
		? scope?.enabled.value
			? new Intl.NumberFormat(scope.locale.value, {
					style: 'percent',
					maximumFractionDigits: 20
				}).format(value / 100)
			: `${value}%`
		: scope?.enabled.value
			? scope.t('app.templates.search.unknownProgress')
			: '进度未知';
}
/** 纯映射；从不写入行、读取权限、发起请求或改变导航。 */
export function searchContent(row: SearchRecord, scope?: AsamI18n): AsamListContent {
	const meta = [
		{
			label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.category') : '类别',
			value: displayValue(row.category, scope)
		},
		{
			label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.status') : '状态',
			value: displayValue(row.status, scope)
		},
		{
			label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.owner') : '负责人',
			value: displayValue(row.owner, scope)
		}
	];
	if (row.kind === 'basic')
		meta.push(
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.reference') : '编号',
				value: row.reference
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.updated') : '更新',
				value: displayDate(row.updatedAt, scope)
			}
		);
	if (row.kind === 'cards')
		meta.push({
			label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.collection') : '合集',
			value: row.collection
		});
	if (row.kind === 'articles')
		meta.push(
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.author') : '作者',
				value: row.author
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.published') : '发布',
				value: displayDate(row.publishedAt, scope)
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.tags') : '标签',
				value:
					row.tags.join(' · ') ||
					(scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.noTags') : '无标签')
			}
		);
	if (row.kind === 'projects')
		meta.push(
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.stage') : '阶段',
				value: displayValue(row.stage, scope)
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.progress') : '进度',
				value: displayProgress(row.progress, scope)
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.start') : '开始',
				value: displayDate(row.startDate, scope)
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.end') : '结束',
				value: displayDate(row.endDate, scope)
			}
		);
	if (row.kind === 'applications')
		meta.push(
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.version') : '版本',
				value: displayValue(row.version, scope)
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.platforms') : '平台',
				value:
					row.platforms.join(' / ') ||
					(scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.notProvided') : '未提供')
			},
			{
				label: scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t('app.templates.search.available') : '可用',
				value: displayValue(row.available, scope)
			}
		);
	return {
		title: row.title,
		description: row.description,
		meta,
		...(row.kind === 'cards' ? { cover: row.cover } : {}),
		...(row.kind === 'projects'
			? {
					avatars: row.members.map((member, index) => ({
						id: `${index}`,
						name: member.name,
						src: member.avatar
					}))
				}
			: {})
	};
}

import { computed } from 'vue';
import type {
	AsamFieldDefinition,
	AsamFieldModel,
	AsamListActionResult,
	AsamListController
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { SearchRecord, SearchSession } from './Types.js';

type QueryAction = AsamListController<SearchRecord>['submit'];

export function createSearchQueryController(
	session: SearchSession,
	view: {
		fields: () => readonly AsamFieldDefinition[];
		encode?: (draft: AsamFieldModel) => AsamFieldModel;
		decode?: (draft: AsamFieldModel) => AsamFieldModel;
		reset?: QueryAction;
		beforeRead?: () => void;
	}
): AsamListController<SearchRecord> {
	const controller = session.controller;
	const ready = computed(
		() =>
			!session.access().disabled && session.access().permitted && controller.scopeReady.value
	);
	function guarded(action: QueryAction): QueryAction {
		return async (validate) => {
			if (!ready.value) return { status: 'blocked' };
			let result: AsamListActionResult = { status: 'blocked' };
			const current = await session.read(async () => {
				view.beforeRead?.();
				result = await action(validate);
			});
			return current ? result : { status: 'cancelled' };
		};
	}
	return {
		...controller,
		fields: computed(view.fields),
		draft: computed(() => view.encode?.(controller.draft.value) ?? controller.draft.value),
		scopeReady: ready,
		setDraft(draft) {
			if (ready.value) controller.setDraft(view.decode?.(draft) ?? draft);
		},
		submit: guarded(controller.submit),
		reset: guarded(view.reset ?? controller.reset)
	};
}

export function keywordQueryField(
	label: string,
	name: string,
	placeholder?: string
): AsamFieldDefinition {
	return {
		key: 'keyword',
		kind: 'text',
		label,
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { name, placeholder, clearable: true } } }
	};
}
ts
import { createAsamMessageError } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import type {} from './i18n/Parameters.js';
import type { AsamListRequest } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { SearchKind, SearchRecord, SearchService } from './Types.js';
import { encodeRowKey } from './Types.js';

const categories = ['设计', '工程', 0, '0', null] as const;
const statuses = ['已就绪', '进行中', false, null] as const;
const owners = ['林岚', '周远', 0, '0', null, undefined] as const;
export const localGraphic = `data:image/svg+xml,${encodeURIComponent('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="600" height="280" viewBox="0 0 600 280"><rect width="600" height="280" fill="#dde8e3"/><path d="M40 240L210 40 380 240ZM260 240L430 40 570 240Z" fill="none" stroke="#46675a" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="300" cy="140" r="62" fill="#a4c3b4"/></svg>')}`;
/** 合成数据固定100条；0与'0'拥有独立typed身份。 */
export function createSearchRecords(kind: SearchKind): SearchRecord[] {
	return Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, index): SearchRecord => {
		const base = {
			id: index === 1 ? '0' : index === 0 ? 0 : index,
			title:
				index === 6
					? '跨团队协作中的设计约束、工程记录与长期内容整理方法'.repeat(3)
					: `${['山海知识', '城市观察', '协作档案', '开放研究'][index % 4]} · ${String(index + 1).padStart(3, '0')}`,
			description:
				index === 6
					? '长内容用于检验窄屏换行与完整阅读。'.repeat(9)
					: '记录设计、工程与协作中的具体方法，提供可追溯的本地演示内容。',
			category: categories[index % categories.length],
			status: statuses[index % statuses.length],
			owner: owners[index % owners.length]
		};
		switch (kind) {
			case 'basic':
				return {
					...base,
					kind,
					reference: `REF-${index + 1}`,
					updatedAt: index % 3 ? '2026-10-12' : undefined
				};
			case 'cards':
				return {
					...base,
					kind,
					cover: {
						src: index === 3 ? './missing-cover.svg' : localGraphic,
						alt: `山海几何构图 ${index + 1}`
					},
					collection: index % 2 ? '空间研究' : '日常设计'
				};
			case 'articles':
				return {
					...base,
					kind,
					author: index % 2 ? '陈澄' : '许知',
					publishedAt: index % 3 ? '2026-10-10' : null,
					tags: ['设计方法', index % 2 ? '案例' : '实践'],
					body: [
						'从一个具体问题开始，记录观察、约束与取舍。',
						'示例正文仅为本地合成文本。<script>不会执行</script>',
						base.description
					]
				};
			case 'projects':
				return {
					...base,
					kind,
					stage: index % 4 ? '宿主阶段：研究验证' : undefined,
					progress: index % 4 ? (index * 7) % 101 : NaN,
					startDate: '2026-09-01',
					endDate: index % 3 ? '2026-12-01' : null,
					members: [
						{ name: '林岚', avatar: index === 2 ? './missing-avatar.svg' : undefined },
						{ name: '周远' }
					]
				};
			case 'applications':
				return {
					...base,
					kind,
					icon: localGraphic,
					version: index % 3 ? '2.1.0' : null,
					platforms: ['Web', '桌面浏览器'],
					available: index % 3 ? true : false,
					route: 'local-demo'
				};
		}
	});
}
export function querySearchRecords(
	rows: readonly SearchRecord[],
	request: AsamListRequest
): { list: SearchRecord[]; total: number } {
	const q = request.query;
	const keyword = typeof q.keyword === 'string' ? q.keyword.trim().toLocaleLowerCase() : '';
	const filtered = rows.filter(
		(row) =>
			(!keyword ||
				`${row.title} ${row.description} ${row.kind === 'articles' ? row.body.join(' ') : ''}`
					.toLocaleLowerCase()
					.includes(keyword)) &&
			['category', 'status', 'owner'].every(
				(key) =>
					q[key] === undefined ||
					Object.is(
						key === 'status' && row.kind === 'applications'
							? row.available
							: Reflect.get(row, key),
						q[key]
					)
			)
	);
	if (request.sort) {
		const { field, order } = request.sort;
		if (!['title', 'id'].includes(field))
			throw createAsamMessageError(
				new TypeError('未允许的排序字段'),
				'app.templates.search.invalidSort'
			);
		filtered.sort(
			(a, b) =>
				String(Reflect.get(a, field)).localeCompare(
					String(Reflect.get(b, field)),
					'zh-CN',
					{ numeric: true }
				) * (order === 'ascending' ? 1 : -1) ||
				encodeRowKey(a.id).localeCompare(encodeRowKey(b.id))
		);
	}
	return {
		list: filtered.slice(
			(request.currentPage - 1) * request.pageSize,
			request.currentPage * request.pageSize
		),
		total: filtered.length
	};
}
/** 这是可替换的合成读取适配，查询/排序作用于全部100条。 */
export function createSearchService(
	kind: SearchKind
): SearchService & { failNext(): void; readonly calls: number } {
	const rows = createSearchRecords(kind);
	let fail = false,
		calls = 0;
	return {
		get calls() {
			return calls;
		},
		failNext() {
			fail = true;
		},
		async read(request, context) {
			calls++;
			const shouldFail = fail;
			fail = false;
			await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
				const abort = () => {
					clearTimeout(timer);
					context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					reject(new DOMException('读取取消', 'AbortError'));
				};
				const timer = setTimeout(() => {
					context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					resolve();
				}, 100);
				if (context.signal.aborted) abort();
				else context.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
			});
			if (shouldFail)
				throw createAsamMessageError(
					'合成读取失败，请重试',
					'app.templates.search.readFailed'
				);
			return querySearchRecords(rows, request);
		}
	};
}
ts
import { createAsamMessageError } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import type {} from './i18n/Parameters.js';
import { effectScope, toValue } from 'vue';
import { createAsamDataRuntime } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useAsamListController } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type {
	AsamFieldDefinition,
	AsamListController,
	AsamListRequest
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { SearchRecord, SearchSession, SearchSessionOptions } from './Types.js';
import { emptyConditions } from './Types.js';
import { searchContent } from './Content.js';

export const searchFields: readonly AsamFieldDefinition[] = [
	{ key: 'keyword', label: '关键词', kind: 'text', defaultValue: () => '' },
	...['category', 'status', 'owner'].map((key) => ({
		key,
		label: { category: '类别', status: '状态', owner: '负责人' }[key] ?? key,
		kind: 'single' as const,
		query: (value: unknown) => value
	}))
];
/** 自有effect scope只释放本会话创建的controller；借入runtime/controller从不dispose。 */
export function createSearchSession(options: SearchSessionOptions): SearchSession {
	if (options.controller && !options.runtime)
		throw createAsamMessageError(
			new TypeError('借入controller必须显式提供其宿主runtime'),
			'app.templates.search.borrowRuntime'
		);
	const scope = effectScope(true);
	const runtime =
		options.runtime ??
		createAsamDataRuntime({
			scope: `search:${options.kind}:${toValue(options.access).identity}`
		});
	let alive = true;
	const access = () => toValue(options.access);
	const guard = () =>
		JSON.stringify([
			runtime.scope,
			runtime.epoch,
			access().identity,
			access().version,
			access().disabled,
			access().permitted
		]);
	const current = (token: string) =>
		alive && !access().disabled && access().permitted && token === guard();
	const accumulatesPages = !!options.accumulatePages && !options.controller;
	const prefixes = new Map<number, readonly SearchRecord[]>();
	const queryKey = (query: AsamListRequest) =>
		JSON.stringify([query.query, query.sort, query.pageSize]);
	const controller: AsamListController<SearchRecord> =
		options.controller ??
		scope.run(() =>
			useAsamListController<SearchRecord>({
				fields: searchFields,
				initial: { ...emptyConditions },
				pageSize: 20,
				immediate: false,
				rowKey: (row) => row.id,
				runtime,
				api: async (request, context) => {
					const token = guard();
					if (!current(token))
						throw createAsamMessageError(
							'当前身份、权限或禁用状态不允许读取',
							'app.templates.search.readDenied'
						);
					let prefix: readonly SearchRecord[] = [];
					if (accumulatesPages) {
						const previous = controller.successfulSource.value;
						if (request.currentPage === 1) prefixes.clear();
						else if (
							previous?.epoch === runtime.epoch &&
							queryKey(previous) === queryKey(request)
						) {
							if (previous.currentPage + 1 === request.currentPage) {
								prefix = controller.page.data.value.list;
								prefixes.set(request.currentPage, prefix);
							} else if (previous.currentPage >= request.currentPage) {
								prefix = prefixes.get(request.currentPage) ?? [];
							}
						}
					}
					const result = await options.service.read(request, context);
					context.signal.throwIfAborted();
					if (!current(token)) throw new DOMException('读取上下文已失效', 'AbortError');
					if (!accumulatesPages || !result.total) return result;
					const records = new Map(
						[...prefix, ...result.list].map((row) => [row.id, row])
					);
					return {
						list: [...records.values()].slice(0, result.total),
						total: result.total
					};
				}
			})
		)!;
	return {
		kind: options.kind,
		accumulatesPages,
		controller,
		runtime,
		content: searchContent,
		access,
		guard,
		current,
		async read(operation) {
			const token = guard();
			if (!current(token)) return false;
			await operation();
			return current(token);
		},
		dispose() {
			if (!alive) return;
			alive = false;
			scope.stop();
		}
	};
}
ts
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type {} from './i18n/Parameters.js';
import type { AsamRowKey, AsamControlSize, AsamDataRuntime } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamListController,
	AsamListRequest,
	AsamListContent,
	AsamListAction
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { MaybeRefOrGetter } from 'vue';

export type SearchKind = 'basic' | 'cards' | 'articles' | 'projects' | 'applications';
export type SearchFamily = 'minimal' | 'brand' | 'technology';
export interface SearchBase {
	readonly id: AsamRowKey;
	readonly kind: SearchKind;
	readonly title: string;
	readonly description: string;
	readonly category: string | number | null;
	readonly status: string | boolean | null;
	readonly owner?: string | number | null;
}
export interface BasicRecord extends SearchBase {
	readonly kind: 'basic';
	readonly updatedAt?: string | null;
	readonly reference: string;
}
export interface CardRecord extends SearchBase {
	readonly kind: 'cards';
	readonly updatedAt?: string;
	readonly cover: { readonly src: string; readonly alt: string };
	readonly collection: string;
}
export interface ArticleRecord extends SearchBase {
	readonly kind: 'articles';
	readonly author: string;
	readonly publishedAt?: string | null;
	readonly tags: readonly string[];
	readonly body: readonly string[];
}
export interface ProjectRecord extends SearchBase {
	readonly kind: 'projects';
	readonly stage?: string | null;
	readonly progress?: number | null;
	readonly startDate?: string | null;
	readonly endDate?: string | null;
	readonly members: readonly { readonly name: string; readonly avatar?: string }[];
}
export interface ApplicationRecord extends SearchBase {
	readonly kind: 'applications';
	readonly icon: string;
	readonly version?: string | null;
	readonly platforms: readonly string[];
	/** 应用可用性；null表示未知，与通用行status独立。P14的status查询映射此字段。 */
	readonly available: boolean | null;
	readonly route: 'local-demo';
}
export type SearchRecord =
	BasicRecord | CardRecord | ArticleRecord | ProjectRecord | ApplicationRecord;
export interface SearchConditions {
	readonly keyword: string;
	readonly category: string | number | null | undefined;
	/** P14映射available：true可用、false不可用、null未知、undefined不限；其他页映射行status。 */
	readonly status: string | boolean | null | undefined;
	readonly owner: string | number | null | undefined;
}
export interface SearchService {
	read(
		request: AsamListRequest,
		context: { readonly signal: AbortSignal }
	): Promise<{ list: SearchRecord[]; total: number }>;
}
export interface SearchAccess {
	readonly identity: string;
	readonly version: string;
	readonly disabled: boolean;
	readonly readonly: boolean;
	readonly permitted: boolean;
}
export interface SearchSessionOptions {
	readonly kind: SearchKind;
	readonly service: SearchService;
	readonly access: MaybeRefOrGetter<SearchAccess>;
	readonly runtime?: AsamDataRuntime;
	readonly controller?: AsamListController<SearchRecord>;
	/** 读取下一批结果时保留已成功返回的前序页面。 */
	readonly accumulatePages?: boolean;
}
export interface SearchPageProps {
	readonly session: SearchSession;
	readonly size?: AsamControlSize;
	/** 宿主返回真实导航结果；事件仅在成功后通知，不作为异步操作回执。 */
	readonly navigatePreview: (row: SearchRecord) => Promise<boolean>;
	/** 独立页面可组合原操作；省略时沿用原只读预览入口。 */
	readonly rowActions?: readonly AsamListAction<SearchRecord>[];
}
export interface SearchSession {
	readonly kind: SearchKind;
	readonly accumulatesPages?: boolean;
	readonly controller: AsamListController<SearchRecord>;
	readonly runtime: AsamDataRuntime;
	readonly content: (row: SearchRecord) => AsamListContent;
	access(): SearchAccess;
	guard(): string;
	current(token: string): boolean;
	read(operation: () => Promise<unknown>): Promise<boolean>;
	dispose(): void;
}
export const searchKinds: readonly SearchKind[] = [
	'basic',
	'cards',
	'articles',
	'projects',
	'applications'
];
export const searchTitles: Readonly<Record<SearchKind, string>> = {
	basic: '资料列表',
	cards: '灵感卡片',
	articles: '文章搜索',
	projects: '项目搜索',
	applications: '应用搜索'
};
export const emptyConditions: SearchConditions = {
	keyword: '',
	category: undefined,
	status: undefined,
	owner: undefined
};
export function encodeRowKey(key: AsamRowKey): string {
	return `${typeof key}:${String(key)}`;
}

export function displaySearchTitle(kind: SearchKind, scope?: AsamI18n): string {
	const keys = {
		basic: 'app.templates.search.titleBasic',
		cards: 'app.templates.search.titleCards',
		articles: 'app.templates.search.titleArticles',
		projects: 'app.templates.search.titleProjects',
		applications: 'app.templates.search.titleApplications'
	} as const;
	return scope?.enabled.value ? scope.t(keys[kind]) : searchTitles[kind];
}

<script setup lang="ts">
import {
	AsamRadioGroup as WebsiteAsamRadioGroup,
	AsamRadioItem as WebsiteAsamRadioItem,
	AsamConfigProvider as WebsiteAsamConfigProvider
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
const websitePreviewControls =
	typeof document !== 'undefined' && !!document.getElementById('preview-settings-extra');

import { onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import SearchPreviewStates from '../shared/SearchPreviewStates.vue';
import { AsamAlert, AsamButton, AsamConfigProvider, AsamOption, AsamSelect } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamFlowSize } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type {} from './Models.js';
import type { BasicFixture, BasicSaveMode } from './Fixture.js';
import { basicSaveModes } from './Fixture.js';
import { useBasicText } from './I18n.js';
import BasicListPage from './BasicListPage.vue';
const props = withDefaults(
	defineProps<{
		fixture: Pick<
			BasicFixture,
			| 'controls'
			| 'access'
			| 'saved'
			| 'deleted'
			| 'toggleReadonly'
			| 'toggleDisabled'
			| 'toggleDenied'
			| 'identity'
			| 'failNext'
			| 'setSaveMode'
			| 'dispose'
		> & { host?: BasicFixture['host'] };
		externalI18n?: AsamI18n;
		inheritAppearance?: boolean;
		showFeedback?: boolean;
		onLocale?: (value: 'zh-CN' | 'en') => void;
	}>(),
	{ showFeedback: true }
);
defineSlots<{
	default?: (scope: { size: AsamFlowSize }) => unknown;
	'preview-options'?: () => unknown;
}>();
const { i18n, t } = useBasicText();
const theme = ref<'light' | 'dark'>('light'),
	size = ref<AsamFlowSize>('default');
const sizes = ['small', 'default', 'big', 'large'] as const;
function setLocale(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'zh-CN' || value === 'en') props.onLocale?.(value);
}
function setTheme(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'light' || value === 'dark') theme.value = value;
}
function setSize(value: unknown) {
	if (sizes.includes(value as AsamFlowSize)) size.value = value as AsamFlowSize;
}
function setMode(value: unknown) {
	if (basicSaveModes.includes(value as BasicSaveMode))
		props.fixture.setSaveMode(value as BasicSaveMode);
}
onBeforeUnmount(props.fixture.dispose);
</script>

<!-- 模板排版沿用仓库Prettier；仅关闭与其冲突的排版规则。 -->
<!-- eslint-disable vue/html-indent, vue/html-closing-bracket-newline, vue/html-self-closing, vue/multiline-html-element-content-newline, vue/max-attributes-per-line -->
<template>
	<main class="basic-list-page" :class="{ 'template-list-wide': wide }" :aria-label="t('title')">
		<header class="basic-list-heading">
			<div>
				<p>{{ t('eyebrow') }}</p>
				<h1>{{ t('title') }}</h1>
			</div>
		</header>
		<QueryForm :session="host.session" :size="size" /><AsamAlert
			v-if="blocked"
			:title="access.disabled ? t('disabled') : t('denied')"
			type="warning"
			:closable="false"
		/><AsamAlert
			v-if="access.readonly"
			:title="t('readonly')"
			type="info"
			:closable="false"
		/><AsamButton
			v-if="!c.scopeReady.value"
			:disabled="blocked"
			@click="resume"
			type="primary"
			>{{ t('resume') }}</AsamButton
		><AsamCard v-if="!blocked" bordered shadow="never" :body-style="{ padding: '24px' }"
			><AsamTabs
				:model-value="statusTab"
				:items="statusTabs"
				@update:model-value="changeStatus"
			/><AsamProList
				class="template-list-results"
				:controller="c"
				:content="content"
				:label="t('title')"
				:layout="layout"
				:card-size="{
					minWidth: layout === 'list' ? 1 : 360,
					minHeight: 0,
					padding: 16,
					contentGap: 8
				}"
				:size="size"
				:readonly="access.readonly"
				hide-refresh
				hide-ready-status
				><template #toolbar
					><ListToolbar
						v-model:wide="wide"
						v-model:layout="layout"
						:label="t('title')"
						:size="size"
						:summary="t('total') + ' ' + c.page.data.value.total + ' ' + t('unit')"
						:tools="tools"
						:create-label="t('create')"
						:create-disabled="actionsBlocked || access.readonly || host.writing()"
						@create="host.workflow.create()"
						@action="runTool" /></template
				><template #title="{ row }"
					><div class="basic-row-title">
						<AsamAvatar shape="square" :size="44">{{
							row.title.slice(0, 1)
						}}</AsamAvatar
						><span class="basic-row-copy"
							><span class="basic-row-name"
								><AsamButton
									class="basic-title"
									type="primary"
									link
									:disabled="actionsBlocked"
									@click="host.workflow.show(row)"
									>{{ row.title }}</AsamButton
								><AsamTag :type="projectStatusType(row.status)">{{
									displayValue(row.status, i18n)
								}}</AsamTag></span
							><span class="basic-row-note">{{ row.description }}</span></span
						>
					</div></template
				><template #extra="{ row }"
					><div class="basic-row-body">
						<div class="basic-owner">
							<small>{{ t('owner') }}</small
							><span>{{ displayValue(row.owner, i18n) }}</span>
						</div>
						<div class="basic-schedule">
							<small>{{ t('planGroup') }}</small
							><span>{{ schedule(row.id) }}</span>
						</div>
						<div class="basic-progress">
							<small>{{ t('progress') }}</small
							><AsamProgress
								v-if="progress(row.id) !== undefined"
								:percentage="progress(row.id)"
								:status="progress(row.id) === 100 ? 'success' : undefined"
							/><span v-else>{{
								displayProgress(host.project(row.id)?.progress, i18n)
							}}</span>
						</div>
						<div class="basic-row-actions">
							<AsamButton
								type="primary"
								text
								:disabled="actionsBlocked || access.readonly || host.writing()"
								@click="host.workflow.edit(row)"
								>{{ t('edit') }}</AsamButton
							><AsamButton
								type="danger"
								text
								:disabled="actionsBlocked || access.readonly || host.writing()"
								@click="host.remove(row)"
								>{{ t('delete') }}</AsamButton
							>
						</div>
					</div></template
				><template #description></template><template #meta></template
				><template #content></template><template #operation></template
				><template #empty><AsamEmpty :description="t('empty')" /></template
			></AsamProList>
			<div
				v-for="record in deletionRecords"
				:key="record.snapshot.operationId"
				class="basic-delete-record"
				role="status"
			>
				<p>
					{{
						t(
							record.results.some((result) => result.status === 'unknown')
								? 'deleteUnknown'
								: record.results.some((result) => result.status === 'failure')
									? 'deleteFailure'
									: record.results.every((result) => result.status === 'success')
										? 'deleteSuccess'
										: 'deleteUnsent'
						)
					}}
				</p>
				<AsamButton
					v-if="record.results.some((result) => result.status === 'unknown')"
					:disabled="!!host.deletions.busy.value.length"
					@click="host.verifyDelete(record.snapshot.operationId)"
					type="primary"
					>{{ t('verifyDelete') }}</AsamButton
				><AsamButton
					v-else-if="record.results.some((result) => result.status === 'failure')"
					:disabled="access.readonly || !!host.deletions.busy.value.length"
					@click="host.retryDelete(record.snapshot.operationId)"
					type="primary"
					>{{ t('retryDelete') }}</AsamButton
				>
			</div></AsamCard
		><RecordOverlays
			:workflow="host.workflow"
			:edit-title="host.workflow.creating.value ? t('createTitle') : t('editTitle')"
			:detail-title="t('detail')"
			:edit-label="t('edit')"
			:close-label="t('close')"
			:field-labels="fieldLabels"
			:size="size"
		/>
	</main>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import ListToolbar from '../../shared/ListToolbar.vue';
import '../../shared/ListSurfaces.css';
import { useSearchListTools } from '../shared/ListTools.js';
import { computed, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamAlert,
	AsamAvatar,
	AsamButton,
	AsamCard,
	AsamEmpty,
	AsamProgress,
	AsamTabs,
	AsamTag
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamCardLayout, AsamControlSize, AsamRowKey } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamProList } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamListContent } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { SearchRecord } from '../Types.js';
import { displayDate, displayProgress, displayValue } from '../Content.js';
import { projectStatusType } from '../shared/ProjectStatus.js';
import RecordOverlays from '../shared/RecordOverlays.vue';
import type { BasicHost } from './Types.js';
import { basicInitial, basicFieldLabels } from './Fields.js';
import { useBasicText } from './I18n.js';
import QueryForm from './QueryForm.vue';
const props = defineProps<{ host: BasicHost; size?: AsamControlSize }>();
const { i18n, t } = useBasicText(),
	c = props.host.session.controller;
const access = computed(() => props.host.session.access());
const blocked = computed(() => access.value.disabled || !access.value.permitted);
const actionsBlocked = computed(() => blocked.value || !c.resultReady.value);
const statusTab = computed(() =>
	typeof c.draft.value.statusTab === 'string' ? c.draft.value.statusTab : ''
);
const statusTabs = computed(() => [
	{ value: '', label: t('allProjects') },
	{ value: '进行中', label: t('inProgress') },
	{ value: '已完成', label: t('completed') }
]);
const wide = shallowRef(false);
const layout = shallowRef<AsamCardLayout>('list');
const { tools, run: runTool } = useSearchListTools(
	props.host.session,
	(key) => t(key),
	() => i18n.t('pro.table.editing.refresh')
);
const fieldLabels = computed(() => basicFieldLabels(t));
const content = (row: SearchRecord): AsamListContent => ({
	title: row.title,
	description: row.description
});
const deletionRecords = computed(() =>
	props.host.deletions.records.value.filter(
		(record) =>
			record.snapshot.context.scope === props.host.session.runtime.scope &&
			record.phase !== 'cancelled'
	)
);
function progress(key: AsamRowKey) {
	const value = props.host.project(key)?.progress;
	return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 && value <= 100
		? value
		: undefined;
}
function schedule(key: AsamRowKey) {
	const project = props.host.project(key);
	if (!project?.startDate && !project?.due) return displayDate(undefined, i18n);
	return `${displayDate(project.startDate || undefined, i18n)} – ${displayDate(project.due || undefined, i18n)}`;
}
async function changeStatus(value: string | number) {
	if (blocked.value || !['', '进行中', '已完成'].includes(String(value))) return;
	c.setDraft({ ...c.draft.value, statusTab: value === '' ? undefined : value });
	await props.host.session.read(() => c.submit());
}
async function resume() {
	if (blocked.value) return;
	c.resumeScope({ ...basicInitial });
	await props.host.session.read(() => c.submit());
}
</script>

.basic-list-page :deep(.asam-list-item) {
	border-radius: 0;
	border-bottom: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
	box-shadow: none;
}

.basic-list-page :deep(.asam-list-heading) {
	min-width: 0;
	flex: 1;
}

.basic-list-page :deep(.asam-card-header) {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
}

/* The inline-size container excludes the page's 32px padding on both sides. */
@container basic-list (width >= 636px) {
	.basic-row-body {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.5fr) minmax(0, 1.2fr) auto;
	}
}

@container basic-list (width >= 936px) {
	.basic-list-page :deep(.asam-card-header) {
		grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 2fr) minmax(0, 3fr);
	}
}

@media (width <= 640px) {
	.basic-list-page {
		padding: 24px 16px;
	}

	.basic-list-heading {
		align-items: start;
	}
}
</style>

import {
	AsamCascader,
	AsamDatePicker,
	AsamInputNumber,
	AsamInputTag,
	AsamSwitch,
	AsamTimePicker,
	defineAsamControl,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamFieldDefinition } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamHierarchyOption } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { BasicLabel } from './I18n.js';
import type { BasicProjectData } from './Types.js';
import UploadField from './UploadField.vue';

export const basicStatuses = ['待启动', '进行中', '已暂停', '已完成'] as const;
const basicRegions = [
	{
		value: 'cn',
		label: '中国',
		raw: { code: 'cn' },
		children: [
			{
				value: 'zj',
				label: '浙江',
				raw: { code: 'zj' },
				children: [{ value: 'hz', label: '杭州', raw: { code: 'hz' } }]
			},
			{
				value: 'sh',
				label: '上海',
				raw: { code: 'sh' },
				children: [{ value: 'pd', label: '浦东', raw: { code: 'pd' } }]
			},
			{
				value: 'gd',
				label: '广东',
				raw: { code: 'gd' },
				children: [{ value: 'sz', label: '深圳', raw: { code: 'sz' } }]
			}
		]
	}
] satisfies readonly AsamHierarchyOption<string, { code: string }>[];
export const basicInitial = {
	keyword: '',
	category: undefined,
	status: undefined,
	owner: undefined,
	reference: '',
	due: '',
	priority: undefined,
	statusTab: undefined
};
export const basicQueryFields: readonly AsamFieldDefinition[] = [
	...['keyword', 'reference', 'due'].map((key) => ({
		key,
		label: key,
		kind: 'text' as const,
		defaultValue: () => ''
	})),
	...['category', 'status', 'owner', 'priority', 'statusTab'].map((key) => ({
		key,
		label: key,
		kind: 'single' as const,
		query: (value: unknown) => value
	}))
];
export const basicProjectDefaults = (): BasicProjectData => ({
	team: '',
	region: null,
	priority: '中',
	startDate: '',
	due: '',
	budget: 0,
	progress: 0,
	channels: [],
	remind: false,
	tags: [],
	time: '09:00',
	files: []
});
export function basicFieldLabels(t: (key: BasicLabel) => string) {
	return {
		title: t('fieldTitle'),
		reference: t('reference'),
		category: t('projectType'),
		owner: t('owner'),
		team: t('team'),
		region: t('region'),
		status: t('status'),
		priority: t('priority'),
		startDate: t('startDate'),
		due: t('due'),
		budget: t('budget'),
		progress: t('progress'),
		channels: t('channels'),
		remind: t('remind'),
		tags: t('tags'),
		time: t('time'),
		files: t('files'),
		description: t('description')
	};
}
const source = (values: readonly (string | number | boolean)[]) =>
	defineAsamOptions().static({
		options: values.map((value) => ({ value, label: String(value) }))
	});
function custom(
	key: string,
	label: string,
	component:
		| typeof AsamInputNumber
		| typeof AsamDatePicker
		| typeof AsamSwitch
		| typeof AsamInputTag
		| typeof AsamCascader
		| typeof AsamTimePicker
		| typeof UploadField,
	isValue: (value: unknown) => boolean,
	empty: () => unknown,
	props: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> = {}
): AsamFieldDefinition {
	return {
		key,
		label,
		kind: 'custom',
		control: defineAsamControl<unknown, object>({
			component,
			emptyValue: empty,
			sourceKinds: []
		}),
		isValue,
		emptyValue: empty,
		isEmpty: (value) => value === null || value === undefined,
		format: (value) =>
			Array.isArray(value)
				? value
						.map((item: unknown) =>
							item && typeof item === 'object' && 'name' in item
								? String(item.name)
								: String(item)
						)
						.join('、')
				: value == null
					? '—'
					: String(value),
		query: (value) => value,
		submit: (value) => value,
		modes: { edit: { componentProps: props } }
	};
}
/** Same18 original B fields, using public ASAM field/editor controls instead of a new form engine. */
export function createBasicFields(t: (key: BasicLabel) => string): readonly AsamFieldDefinition[] {
	const label = basicFieldLabels(t);
	const string = (value: unknown) => typeof value === 'string';
	const strings = (value: unknown) => Array.isArray(value) && value.every(string);
	const numeric = (value: unknown) => typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value);
	const date = (value: unknown) => value === null || string(value);
	const fields: readonly AsamFieldDefinition[] = [
		{
			key: 'title',
			label: label.title,
			kind: 'text',
			modes: {
				edit: {
					rules: [{ required: true, whitespace: true, message: () => t('required') }]
				}
			}
		},
		{
			key: 'reference',
			label: label.reference,
			kind: 'text',
			modes: { edit: { readonly: true } }
		},
		{
			key: 'category',
			label: label.category,
			kind: 'single',
			source: source(['平台建设', '流程优化', '数据分析', '设计', '工程', 0, '0'])
		},
		{ key: 'owner', label: label.owner, kind: 'text' },
		{
			key: 'team',
			label: label.team,
			kind: 'single',
			source: source(['平台研发组', '客户体验组', '供应链小组', '数据产品组'])
		},
		custom(
			'region',
			label.region,
			AsamCascader,
			(value) => value === null || string(value),
			() => null,
			{
				props: { emitPath: false },
				options: basicRegions
			}
		),
		{
			key: 'status',
			label: label.status,
			kind: 'single',
			source: source([...basicStatuses, false])
		},
		{
			key: 'priority',
			label: label.priority,
			kind: 'single',
			control: 'radio',
			source: source(['高', '中', '低'])
		},
		custom('startDate', label.startDate, AsamDatePicker, date, () => '', {
			valueFormat: 'YYYY-MM-DD',
			type: 'date'
		}),
		custom('due', label.due, AsamDatePicker, date, () => '', {
			valueFormat: 'YYYY-MM-DD',
			type: 'date'
		}),
		custom('budget', label.budget, AsamInputNumber, numeric, () => 0, {
			min: 0,
			controlsPosition: 'right'
		}),
		custom(
			'progress',
			label.progress,
			AsamInputNumber,
			(value) => value === null || numeric(value),
			() => null,
			{ min: 0, max: 100 }
		),
		{
			key: 'channels',
			label: label.channels,
			kind: 'multiple',
			control: 'checkbox',
			source: source(['站内消息', '邮件'])
		},
		custom(
			'remind',
			label.remind,
			AsamSwitch,
			(value) => typeof value === 'boolean',
			() => false
		),
		// 编辑器拥有数组快照；标签在保存时统一校验，避免引用变化重复触发即时校验。
		custom('tags', label.tags, AsamInputTag, strings, () => [], { validateEvent: false }),
		custom('time', label.time, AsamTimePicker, date, () => '', {
			format: 'HH:mm',
			valueFormat: 'HH:mm'
		}),
		custom(
			'files',
			label.files,
			UploadField,
			(value) =>
				Array.isArray(value) &&
				value.every(
					(item: unknown) =>
						!!item &&
						typeof item === 'object' &&
						'id' in item &&
						typeof item.id === 'string'
				),
			() => []
		),
		{ key: 'description', label: label.description, kind: 'textarea' }
	];
	return fields.map((field, index) => ({
		...field,
		modes: {
			...field.modes,
			edit: {
				...field.modes?.edit,
				layout: {
					get group() {
						return t(
							index < 6
								? 'basicGroup'
								: index < 12
									? 'planGroup'
									: index < 16
										? 'collaborationGroup'
										: 'resourcesGroup'
						);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}));
}

import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { BasicRecord } from '../Types.js';
import { createSearchRecords } from '../Service.js';
import { createProjectFixture } from '../shared/ProjectFixture.js';
import { basicProjectDefaults, createBasicFields } from './Fields.js';
import { basicModel, validateBasicModel } from './Model.js';
export { basicSaveModes } from '../shared/ProjectFixture.js';
export type { BasicSaveMode } from '../shared/ProjectFixture.js';

/** 标准列表仅声明原BasicRecord的表单映射；状态过程由共享宿主与原库控制器负责。 */
export function createBasicFixture(
	i18n: AsamI18n,
	options: { confirmDelete?: (title: string) => Promise<boolean> } = {}
) {
	return createProjectFixture<BasicRecord>(
		i18n,
		{
			kind: 'basic',
			namespace: 'basic-list',
			prefix: 'basic',
			seed: createSearchRecords('basic').filter(
				(row): row is BasicRecord => row.kind === 'basic'
			),
			fields: createBasicFields,
			reference: (row) => row.reference,
			model: basicModel,
			defaults: (t) =>
				basicModel(
					{
						id: '',
						kind: 'basic',
						title: '',
						description: '',
						reference: t('autoReference'),
						category: '平台建设',
						status: '待启动',
						owner: ''
					},
					basicProjectDefaults()
				),
			validate: validateBasicModel,
			record(value, id, reference, current) {
				return {
					id,
					kind: 'basic',
					title: String(value.title).trim(),
					description: String(value.description),
					reference,
					category:
						typeof value.category === 'string' || typeof value.category === 'number'
							? value.category
							: null,
					status:
						typeof value.status === 'string' || typeof value.status === 'boolean'
							? value.status
							: null,
					owner:
						current && String(value.owner) === String(current.owner ?? '')
							? current.owner
							: String(value.owner),
					updatedAt: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)
				};
			}
		},
		options
	);
}
export type BasicFixture = ReturnType<typeof createBasicFixture>;

import type { AsamFieldModel } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamUploadedResource } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { BasicRecord } from '../Types.js';
import type { BasicProjectData } from './Types.js';
import type { BasicLabel } from './I18n.js';

import { projectFormModel } from '../shared/ProjectModel.js';

export function basicModel(row: BasicRecord, project: BasicProjectData): AsamFieldModel {
	return projectFormModel(row, row.reference, project);
}
const strings = (value: unknown): value is string[] =>
	Array.isArray(value) && value.every((item: unknown) => typeof item === 'string');
const files = (value: unknown): value is AsamUploadedResource[] =>
	Array.isArray(value) &&
	value.every(
		(item: unknown) =>
			!!item &&
			typeof item === 'object' &&
			'id' in item &&
			typeof item.id === 'string' &&
			'name' in item &&
			typeof item.name === 'string' &&
			'url' in item &&
			typeof item.url === 'string' &&
			'mimeType' in item &&
			typeof item.mimeType === 'string' &&
			'size' in item &&
			typeof item.size === 'number' &&
			Number.isFinite(item.size) &&
			item.size >= 0
	);

/** Custom editor fields declare value equality through the original public editor contract. */
export const basicEquals: Readonly<Record<string, (a: unknown, b: unknown) => boolean>> = {
	...Object.fromEntries(
		['region', 'startDate', 'due', 'budget', 'progress', 'remind', 'time'].map((key) => [
			key,
			Object.is
		])
	),
	tags: (a, b) =>
		strings(a) &&
		strings(b) &&
		a.length === b.length &&
		a.every((value, index) => value === b[index]),
	files: (a, b) =>
		files(a) &&
		files(b) &&
		a.length === b.length &&
		a.every((value, index) => {
			const other = b[index];
			return (
				value.id === other.id &&
				value.name === other.name &&
				value.url === other.url &&
				value.mimeType === other.mimeType &&
				value.size === other.size
			);
		})
};
export function validBasicTypes(value: Readonly<AsamFieldModel>): boolean {
	return (
		['title', 'reference', 'owner', 'team', 'priority', 'description'].every(
			(key) => typeof value[key] === 'string'
		) &&
		(value.category === null ||
			typeof value.category === 'string' ||
			typeof value.category === 'number') &&
		(value.status === null ||
			typeof value.status === 'string' ||
			typeof value.status === 'boolean') &&
		(value.region === null || typeof value.region === 'string') &&
		['startDate', 'due', 'time'].every(
			(key) => value[key] === null || typeof value[key] === 'string'
		) &&
		typeof value.budget === 'number' &&
		Number.isFinite(value.budget) &&
		(value.progress === null ||
			(typeof value.progress === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value.progress))) &&
		strings(value.channels) &&
		strings(value.tags) &&
		typeof value.remind === 'boolean' &&
		files(value.files)
	);
}
export function validateBasicModel(
	value: Readonly<AsamFieldModel>,
	t: (label: BasicLabel) => string
) {
	const issues: { key?: string; message: string }[] = [];
	if (!validBasicTypes(value)) issues.push({ message: t('invalidModel') });
	if (typeof value.title !== 'string' || !value.title.trim())
		issues.push({ key: 'title', message: t('required') });
	if (typeof value.budget !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value.budget) || value.budget < 0)
		issues.push({ key: 'budget', message: t('invalidBudget') });
	if (
		value.progress !== null &&
		(typeof value.progress !== 'number' ||
			!Number.isFinite(value.progress) ||
			value.progress < 0 ||
			value.progress > 100)
	)
		issues.push({ key: 'progress', message: t('invalidProgress') });
	for (const key of ['startDate', 'due']) {
		const date = value[key];
		if (
			date &&
			(typeof date !== 'string' ||
				!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(date) ||
				!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(date)) ||
				new Date(date).toISOString().slice(0, 10) !== date)
		)
			issues.push({ key, message: t('invalidDate') });
	}
	if (value.startDate && value.due && String(value.due) < String(value.startDate))
		issues.push({ key: 'due', message: t('invalidRange') });
	return issues;
}
export function projectFromModel(value: Readonly<AsamFieldModel>): BasicProjectData | undefined {
	if (
		!validBasicTypes(value) ||
		!strings(value.channels) ||
		!strings(value.tags) ||
		!files(value.files)
	)
		return;
	return {
		team: String(value.team),
		region: value.region === null ? null : String(value.region),
		priority: String(value.priority),
		startDate: String(value.startDate ?? ''),
		due: String(value.due ?? ''),
		budget: Number(value.budget),
		progress: value.progress === null ? null : Number(value.progress),
		channels: [...value.channels],
		remind: value.remind === true,
		tags: [...value.tags],
		time: String(value.time ?? ''),
		files: value.files.map((file) => ({ ...file }))
	};
}

<template>
	<AsamSearchForm
		:controller="controller"
		:size="size"
		:columns="3"
		:collapsed-count="3"
		:loading="controller.page.loading.value"
		:submit-label="t('search')"
		:reset-label="t('reset')"
		compact
		card
		><template #footer
			><p v-if="controller.dirty.value" role="status">{{ t('draft') }}</p></template
		></AsamSearchForm
	>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamSearchForm } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { SearchSession } from '../Types.js';
import { displayValue } from '../Content.js';
import { keywordQueryField } from '../QueryController.js';
import { createTableSearchQueryController } from '../table-list/QueryController.js';
import { useBasicText } from './I18n.js';

const props = defineProps<{ session: SearchSession; size?: AsamControlSize }>();
const { i18n, t } = useBasicText();
const controller = createTableSearchQueryController(
	props.session,
	t,
	i18n,
	(fields) =>
		fields.map((field) => {
			if (field.key === 'keyword') return keywordQueryField(t('fieldTitle'), 'basic-keyword');
			if (field.key === 'reference')
				return {
					...field,
					modes: {
						query: { componentProps: { name: 'basic-reference', clearable: true } }
					}
				};
			return field;
		}),
	(value) =>
		value === undefined
			? t('all')
			: displayValue(value, i18n) +
				(value === 0 ? ' (number)' : value === '0' ? ' (string)' : '')
);
</script>

import type { AsamRowKey, AsamUploadedResource } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamCrossPageSelection,
	AsamTableOperationCoordinator
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { SearchRecord, SearchSession } from '../Types.js';
import type { useRecordWorkflow } from '../shared/RecordWorkflow.js';

/** Original B project-form data supplied by the frontend host; no backend DTO is implied. */
export interface BasicProjectData {
	readonly team: string;
	readonly region: string | null;
	readonly priority: string;
	readonly startDate: string;
	readonly due: string;
	readonly budget: number;
	readonly progress: number | null;
	readonly channels: readonly string[];
	readonly remind: boolean;
	readonly tags: readonly string[];
	readonly time: string;
	readonly files: readonly AsamUploadedResource[];
}
export interface BasicHost {
	readonly session: SearchSession;
	readonly workflow: ReturnType<typeof useRecordWorkflow<SearchRecord>>;
	readonly project: (key: AsamRowKey) => BasicProjectData | undefined;
	readonly deletions: AsamTableOperationCoordinator;
	readonly deletionSelection: AsamCrossPageSelection;
	readonly writing: () => boolean;
	remove(row: SearchRecord): Promise<void>;
	retryDelete(id: string): Promise<void>;
	verifyDelete(id: string): Promise<void>;
}
vue
<!-- 模板排版沿用仓库Prettier；仅关闭与其冲突的排版规则。 -->
<!-- eslint-disable vue/html-indent, vue/html-closing-bracket-newline, vue/html-self-closing, vue/multiline-html-element-content-newline, vue/max-attributes-per-line -->
<template>
	<AsamUpload
		:model-value="modelValue"
		multiple
		:upload="simulateUpload"
		:max-size-bytes="20 * 1024 * 1024"
		:disabled="disabled"
		accept=".pdf,.doc,.docx,.png,.jpg,.jpeg"
		drag
		@update:model-value="update"
		><p>{{ t('upload') }}</p>
		<template #tip>{{ t('uploadTip') }}</template></AsamUpload
	>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamUpload } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamUploadedResource, AsamUploadHandler, AsamUploadValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useBasicText } from './I18n.js';
defineProps<{ modelValue: readonly AsamUploadedResource[]; disabled?: boolean }>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ 'update:modelValue': [value: AsamUploadedResource[]] }>();
const { t } = useBasicText();
const simulateUpload: AsamUploadHandler = async ({ file }, context) => {
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size / 2, total: file.size });
	await new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 80));
	if (context.signal.aborted) throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
	context.reportProgress({ loaded: file.size, total: file.size });
	return {
		id: `local-${file.name}-${file.size}`,
		name: file.name,
		url: `/__local-preview__/${encodeURIComponent(file.name)}`,
		mimeType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream',
		size: file.size
	};
};
function update(value: AsamUploadValue) {
	if (Array.isArray(value)) emit('update:modelValue', [...value]);
}
</script>

import { computed } from 'vue';
import { Bottom, Refresh, Sort, Top } from '@asam-ui/icons-vue';
import type { ListToolbarTool } from '../../shared/ListToolbarTypes.js';
import type { SearchSession } from '../Types.js';

const modes = [
	{ sort: null, label: 'defaultSort', icon: Sort },
	{ sort: { field: 'title', order: 'ascending' }, label: 'titleAsc', icon: Top },
	{ sort: { field: 'title', order: 'descending' }, label: 'titleDesc', icon: Bottom }
] as const;

type SortLabel = (typeof modes)[number]['label'];

export function useSearchListTools(
	session: SearchSession,
	sortLabel: (key: SortLabel) => string,
	refreshLabel: () => string,
	{ refreshFromStart = false } = {}
) {
	const c = session.controller;
	const canQuery = computed(() => {
		const access = session.access();
		return access.permitted && !access.disabled && c.scopeReady.value;
	});
	const canRead = computed(() => canQuery.value && !c.page.loading.value);
	const sortIndex = computed(() => {
		const sort = c.intent.value?.sort;
		return Math.max(
			0,
			modes.findIndex(
				({ sort: mode }) => mode?.field === sort?.field && mode?.order === sort?.order
			)
		);
	});
	const tools = computed<readonly ListToolbarTool[]>(() => {
		const mode = modes[sortIndex.value] ?? modes[0];
		return [
			{
				id: 'sort',
				label: sortLabel(mode.label),
				icon: mode.icon,
				disabled: !canQuery.value || !c.intent.value,
				ariaDisabled: canQuery.value && !canRead.value,
				pressed: sortIndex.value !== 0,
				state: sortIndex.value === 0 ? 'default-sort' : undefined
			},
			{ id: 'refresh', label: refreshLabel(), icon: Refresh, disabled: !canRead.value }
		];
	});
	function run(id: string) {
		if (!canRead.value) return;
		if (id === 'sort' && c.intent.value) {
			const next = modes[(sortIndex.value + 1) % modes.length] ?? modes[0];
			void session.read(() => c.setSort(next.sort));
		}
		if (id === 'refresh') {
			const intent = c.intent.value;
			void session.read(() =>
				refreshFromStart && intent && intent.currentPage > 1
					? c.setSort(intent.sort)
					: c.refresh()
			);
		}
	}
	return { tools, run };
}

import { effectScope, reactive, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamMessageBox, createAsamDataRuntime } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import {
	createAsamWriteCoordinator,
	createAsamTableOperationCoordinator,
	useAsamListController,
	useAsamCrossPageSelection
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type {
	AsamSaveResult,
	AsamTableOperation,
	AsamOperationRecord,
	AsamFieldDefinition,
	AsamFieldModel
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamRowKey } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { extendAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { createSearchSession } from '../Session.js';
import { querySearchRecords } from '../Service.js';
import type {
	BasicRecord,
	CardRecord,
	SearchRecord,
	SearchAccess,
	SearchSession,
	SearchService
} from '../Types.js';
import { useRecordWorkflow } from '../shared/RecordWorkflow.js';
import { basicMessages } from '../basic-list/I18n.js';
import type { BasicLabel } from '../basic-list/I18n.js';
import {
	basicInitial,
	basicQueryFields,
	basicProjectDefaults,
	basicStatuses
} from '../basic-list/Fields.js';
import { basicEquals, projectFromModel } from '../basic-list/Model.js';
import type { BasicHost, BasicProjectData } from '../basic-list/Types.js';

export const basicSaveModes = ['success', 'failure', 'unknown-applied'] as const;
export type BasicSaveMode = (typeof basicSaveModes)[number];
export interface ProjectFixtureData extends BasicProjectData {
	readonly reference: string;
}
export interface ProjectFixtureAdapter<Row extends BasicRecord | CardRecord> {
	readonly kind: Row['kind'];
	readonly namespace: string;
	readonly prefix: string;
	readonly seed: readonly Row[];
	fields(t: (key: BasicLabel) => string): readonly AsamFieldDefinition[];
	reference(row: Row): string;
	model(row: Row, data: ProjectFixtureData): AsamFieldModel;
	defaults(t: (key: BasicLabel) => string): AsamFieldModel;
	record(value: Readonly<AsamFieldModel>, id: AsamRowKey, reference: string, current?: Row): Row;
	validate(
		value: Readonly<AsamFieldModel>,
		t: (key: BasicLabel) => string
	): readonly { key?: string; message: string }[];
}
type MutableAccess = { -readonly [K in keyof SearchAccess]: SearchAccess[K] };
/** Own local normalized data. Native library controllers own all read/editor/delete state transitions. */
export function createProjectFixture<Row extends BasicRecord | CardRecord>(
	i18n: AsamI18n,
	adapter: ProjectFixtureAdapter<Row>,
	options: { confirmDelete?: (title: string) => Promise<boolean> } = {}
) {
	const scope = effectScope(true),
		textScope = extendAsamI18n(i18n, basicMessages);
	const text = (key: BasicLabel) =>
		textScope.t(...([`app.templates.basicList.${key}`] as Parameters<AsamI18n['t']>));
	const access = reactive<MutableAccess>({
		identity: adapter.prefix + '-reader-a',
		version: '1',
		disabled: false,
		readonly: false,
		permitted: true
	});
	const controls = reactive({ save: 'success' as BasicSaveMode, failNext: false });
	const saved = shallowRef(false),
		deleted = shallowRef(false);
	const audit = {
		reads: 0,
		saves: 0,
		commits: 0,
		verifies: 0,
		deleteSends: 0,
		deleteCommits: 0,
		deleteVerifies: 0
	};
	const seed = adapter.seed.slice(0, 25).map((row, index): Row => ({
		...row,
		status: index === 23 ? false : index === 24 ? null : basicStatuses[index % 4]
	}));
	const seedProjects = new Map<AsamRowKey, ProjectFixtureData>(
		seed.map((row, index) => [
			row.id,
			{
				...basicProjectDefaults(),
				reference: adapter.reference(row),
				team: '平台研发组',
				region: index === 0 ? null : 'hz',
				priority: ['高', '中', '低'][index % 3],
				startDate: '2026-10-30',
				due: index === 0 ? '' : '2026-11-30',
				progress: index === 0 ? 0 : index === 1 ? null : index % 4 === 3 ? 100 : 72,
				channels: index === 0 ? [] : ['站内消息', '邮件'],
				remind: index !== 0,
				time: index === 0 ? '00:00' : '09:00'
			}
		])
	);
	const stores = new Map<string, Map<AsamRowKey, Row>>(),
		projects = new Map<string, Map<AsamRowKey, ProjectFixtureData>>();
	const versions = new Map<string, Map<AsamRowKey, number>>();
	const writes = createAsamWriteCoordinator(),
		deletions = createAsamTableOperationCoordinator();
	const operations = new Map<string, { id: AsamRowKey; result: AsamSaveResult }>();
	const deleteJournal = new Set<string>();
	const operationIds = new Map<string, string>();
	const createOperations = new Map<string, string>();
	let sequence = 0,
		session: SearchSession;
	function store(owner: string) {
		let rows = stores.get(owner);
		if (!rows) {
			rows = new Map(seed.map((row) => [row.id, { ...row }]));
			stores.set(owner, rows);
		}
		return rows;
	}
	function projectStore(owner: string) {
		let rows = projects.get(owner);
		if (!rows) {
			rows = new Map(seedProjects);
			projects.set(owner, rows);
		}
		return rows;
	}
	function rowVersion(owner: string, key: AsamRowKey) {
		return versions.get(owner)?.get(key) ?? 1;
	}
	function bump(owner: string, key: AsamRowKey) {
		let values = versions.get(owner);
		if (!values) {
			values = new Map();
			versions.set(owner, values);
		}
		values.set(key, rowVersion(owner, key) + 1);
	}
	async function wait(signal?: AbortSignal) {
		await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
			const finish = () => {
				signal?.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
				resolve();
			};
			const timer = setTimeout(finish, 80);
			const abort = () => {
				clearTimeout(timer);
				signal?.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
				reject(new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError'));
			};
			if (signal?.aborted) abort();
			else signal?.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
		});
	}
	const service: SearchService = {
		async read(request, context) {
			audit.reads++;
			const owner = session.runtime.scope;
			await wait(context.signal);
			if (controls.failNext) {
				controls.failNext = false;
				throw new Error('Synthetic basic-list read failed');
			}
			const q = request.query;
			const rows = [...store(owner).values()].filter((row) => {
				const data = projectStore(owner).get(row.id);
				return (
					(!q.reference || data?.reference.includes(String(q.reference))) &&
					(!q.due || data?.due === q.due) &&
					(q.priority === undefined || data?.priority === q.priority) &&
					(q.statusTab === undefined || Object.is(row.status, q.statusTab))
				);
			});
			return querySearchRecords(rows, request);
		}
	};
	const owned = scope.run(() => {
		const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime({
			scope: JSON.stringify([adapter.namespace, access.identity])
		});
		const controller = useAsamListController<SearchRecord>({
			runtime,
			fields: basicQueryFields,
			initial: { ...basicInitial },
			pageSize: 10,
			rowKey: (row) => row.id,
			immediate: false,
			api: async (request, context) => {
				const token = session.guard();
				if (!session.current(token))
					throw new DOMException('Scope unavailable', 'AbortError');
				const result = await service.read(request, context);
				if (!session.current(token)) throw new DOMException('Stale read', 'AbortError');
				return result;
			}
		});
		session = createSearchSession({
			kind: adapter.kind,
			service,
			access: () => access,
			runtime,
			controller
		});
		const selection = useAsamCrossPageSelection({ controller, dataset: () => session.guard() });
		const deletePending = () =>
			!!deletions.busy.value.length ||
			deletions.records.value.some(
				(record) =>
					record.snapshot.context.scope === runtime.scope &&
					record.results.some((result) => result.status === 'unknown')
			);
		const allowed = (action: 'detail' | 'edit', row: SearchRecord) =>
			row.kind === adapter.kind &&
			session.current(session.guard()) &&
			controller.resultReady.value &&
			(action === 'detail' || (!access.readonly && !deletePending()));
		async function refreshFirst() {
			controller.clearSelection();
			if (controller.intent.value?.currentPage === 1)
				await session.read(() => controller.refresh());
			else await session.read(() => controller.setPage(1));
		}
		const fields = adapter.fields(text);
		const model = (row: Row) =>
			adapter.model(
				row,
				projectStore(runtime.scope).get(row.id) ?? {
					...basicProjectDefaults(),
					reference: adapter.reference(row)
				}
			);
		const workflow = useRecordWorkflow<SearchRecord>({
			runtime,
			fields,
			key: (row) => row.id,
			resolve: (key) => controller.page.data.value.list.find((row) => row.id === key),
			allowed,
			context: () =>
				JSON.stringify([
					session.guard(),
					controller.intent.value?.query,
					controller.intent.value?.sort
				]),
			create: {
				allowed: () =>
					session.current(session.guard()) &&
					controller.resultReady.value &&
					!access.readonly &&
					!deletePending(),
				operationId: () => {
					saved.value = deleted.value = false;
					const createOperation = createOperations.get(runtime.scope);
					const status = createOperation
						? writes.get(runtime.scope, createOperation)?.status
						: undefined;
					if (createOperation && (status === 'saving' || status === 'unknown'))
						return createOperation;
					const next = adapter.prefix + '-create-' + ++sequence;
					createOperations.set(runtime.scope, next);
					return next;
				}
			},
			detail: (row) => ({
				mode: 'load',
				id: row.id,
				load: async (id, context) => {
					await wait(context.signal);
					const current = store(context.scope).get(id),
						data = projectStore(context.scope).get(id);
					return current && data
						? { status: 'ready', data: adapter.model(current, data) }
						: { status: 'missing' };
				}
			}),
			operationId: (row) => {
				saved.value = deleted.value = false;
				const key = JSON.stringify([runtime.scope, typeof row.id, row.id]),
					previous = operationIds.get(key),
					status = previous ? writes.get(runtime.scope, previous)?.status : undefined;
				if (previous && (status === 'saving' || status === 'unknown')) return previous;
				const next = adapter.prefix + '-edit-' + ++sequence;
				operationIds.set(key, next);
				return next;
			},
			editor: {
				coordinator: writes,
				equals: basicEquals,
				defaults: async () => adapter.defaults(text),
				load: async (target, context) => {
					await wait(context.signal);
					const row =
						target.id === undefined ? undefined : store(context.scope).get(target.id);
					if (!row) throw new Error('Basic record missing');
					return model(row);
				},
				validatePayload: async (value) => adapter.validate(value, text),
				formatError: (cause) =>
					cause && typeof cause === 'object' && 'status' in cause
						? cause.status === 'unknown'
							? text('saveUnknown')
							: cause.status === 'failure'
								? text('saveDenied')
								: text('operationError')
						: text('operationError'),
				async save(value, operation, context) {
					audit.saves++;
					const mode = controls.save,
						key = JSON.stringify([operation.scope, operation.target.operationId]),
						previous = operations.get(key);
					if (previous) return previous.result;
					await wait(context.signal);
					if (mode === 'failure')
						return { status: 'failure', message: text('saveDenied') };
					const id = operation.target.id ?? 'new-' + operation.target.operationId,
						current = store(context.scope).get(id),
						data = projectFromModel(value);
					if (
						!data ||
						adapter.validate(value, text).length ||
						(operation.target.mode === 'edit' && !current)
					)
						return { status: 'failure', message: text('saveDenied') };
					const reference =
						projectStore(context.scope).get(id)?.reference ??
						'PRJ-' + operation.target.operationId;
					const row = adapter.record(value, id, reference, current);
					if (operation.target.mode === 'create') {
						const rows = [...store(context.scope)];
						store(context.scope).clear();
						store(context.scope).set(id, row);
						for (const [key, value] of rows) store(context.scope).set(key, value);
					} else store(context.scope).set(id, row);
					projectStore(context.scope).set(id, { ...data, reference });
					bump(context.scope, id);
					audit.commits++;
					const result: AsamSaveResult = { status: 'success', data: { id } };
					operations.set(key, { id, result });
					return mode === 'unknown-applied'
						? { status: 'unknown', message: text('saveUnknown') }
						: result;
				},
				async verify(operation, context) {
					audit.verifies++;
					await wait(context.signal);
					const original = operations.get(
						JSON.stringify([operation.scope, operation.target.operationId])
					);
					return original
						? { status: 'success', data: { id: original.id } }
						: { status: 'unknown' };
				},
				confirmDiscard: () =>
					AsamMessageBox.confirm(text('discard'), text('editTitle'), {
						confirmButtonText: text('confirm'),
						cancelButtonText: text('cancel')
					}).then(
						() => true,
						() => false
					),
				onSaved: () => {
					saved.value = true;
					deleted.value = false;
					void refreshFirst();
					if (workflow.detail.active.value) void workflow.detail.refresh();
				}
			}
		});
		const editorPending = () =>
			workflow.editor?.busy.value || workflow.editor?.status.value === 'unknown';
		const deletion: AsamTableOperation = {
			id: 'basic-delete',
			label: text('delete'),
			busyKey: 'basic-delete',
			allowed: (target, context) =>
				context.scope === runtime.scope &&
				session.current(session.guard()) &&
				!access.readonly &&
				!editorPending() &&
				controller.resultReady.value &&
				store(context.scope).has(target.key) &&
				String(rowVersion(context.scope, target.key)) === target.version,
			resolve: async (keys, context) =>
				keys.map((key) => {
					const row = store(context.scope).get(key);
					return row
						? {
								key,
								target: {
									key,
									version: String(rowVersion(context.scope, key)),
									payload: { title: row.title }
								}
							}
						: { key, reason: text('deleteFailure') };
				}),
			confirm: (snapshot) => {
				const title =
					text('deleteConfirm') +
					' ' +
					snapshot.targets
						.map((target) =>
							target.payload &&
							typeof target.payload === 'object' &&
							!Array.isArray(target.payload) &&
							'title' in target.payload
								? String(target.payload.title)
								: String(target.key)
						)
						.join('、');
				return options.confirmDelete
					? options.confirmDelete(title)
					: AsamMessageBox.confirm(title, text('delete'), {
							type: 'warning',
							confirmButtonText: text('confirm'),
							cancelButtonText: text('cancel')
						}).then(
							() => true,
							() => false
						);
			},
			async execute(target, snapshot) {
				audit.deleteSends++;
				const mode = controls.save,
					journalKey = JSON.stringify([
						snapshot.context.scope,
						snapshot.operationId,
						typeof target.key,
						target.key
					]);
				await wait();
				if (mode === 'failure')
					return { key: target.key, status: 'failure', message: text('deleteFailure') };
				if (!deleteJournal.has(journalKey)) {
					store(snapshot.context.scope).delete(target.key);
					projectStore(snapshot.context.scope).delete(target.key);
					bump(snapshot.context.scope, target.key);
					deleteJournal.add(journalKey);
					audit.deleteCommits++;
				}
				return {
					key: target.key,
					status: mode === 'unknown-applied' ? 'unknown' : 'success',
					message:
						mode === 'unknown-applied' ? text('deleteUnknown') : text('deleteSuccess')
				};
			},
			async verify(target, snapshot) {
				audit.deleteVerifies++;
				await wait();
				return {
					key: target.key,
					status: deleteJournal.has(
						JSON.stringify([
							snapshot.context.scope,
							snapshot.operationId,
							typeof target.key,
							target.key
						])
					)
						? 'success'
						: 'unknown',
					message: text('deleteUnknown')
				};
			}
		};
		async function acceptDelete(record: AsamOperationRecord | null) {
			if (
				record &&
				record.snapshot.context.scope === runtime.scope &&
				session.current(session.guard()) &&
				JSON.stringify(record.snapshot.context) === JSON.stringify(selection.context()) &&
				record.results.length &&
				record.results.every((result) => result.status === 'success')
			) {
				deleted.value = true;
				saved.value = false;
				await refreshFirst();
			}
		}
		const host: BasicHost = {
			session,
			workflow,
			project: (key) => projectStore(runtime.scope).get(key),
			deletions,
			deletionSelection: selection,
			writing: () => !!editorPending() || deletePending(),
			async remove(row) {
				if (
					!allowed('edit', row) ||
					editorPending() ||
					!controller.page.data.value.list.some((item) => item.id === row.id)
				)
					return;
				const pending = deletions.records.value.find(
					(record) =>
						record.snapshot.context.scope === runtime.scope &&
						record.results.some(
							(result) => result.key === row.id && result.status === 'unknown'
						)
				);
				if (pending) return;
				saved.value = deleted.value = false;
				await acceptDelete(
					await deletions.run(
						deletion,
						adapter.prefix + '-delete-' + ++sequence,
						[row.id],
						selection
					)
				);
			},
			async retryDelete(id) {
				await acceptDelete(await deletions.retry(id, selection));
			},
			async verifyDelete(id) {
				if (
					!session.current(session.guard()) ||
					deletions.records.value.find((record) => record.snapshot.operationId === id)
						?.snapshot.context.scope !== runtime.scope
				)
					return;
				await acceptDelete(await deletions.verify(id));
			}
		};
		return { host, selection };
	})!;
	let version = 1,
		disposed = false;
	async function rebind() {
		saved.value = deleted.value = false;
		access.version = String(++version);
		const nextScope = JSON.stringify([adapter.namespace, access.identity]);
		if (session.runtime.scope === nextScope) session.runtime.invalidate();
		else session.runtime.setScope(nextScope);
		session.controller.resumeScope({ ...basicInitial });
		if (!access.disabled && access.permitted)
			await session.read(() => session.controller.submit());
	}
	return {
		host: owned.host,
		controls,
		access,
		saved,
		deleted,
		audit,
		async initialize() {
			await session.read(() => session.controller.submit());
		},
		async identity() {
			access.identity =
				access.identity === adapter.prefix + '-reader-a'
					? adapter.prefix + '-reader-b'
					: adapter.prefix + '-reader-a';
			await rebind();
		},
		async toggleReadonly() {
			access.readonly = !access.readonly;
		},
		async toggleDisabled() {
			access.disabled = !access.disabled;
			await rebind();
		},
		async toggleDenied() {
			access.permitted = !access.permitted;
			await rebind();
		},
		failNext() {
			controls.failNext = true;
		},
		setSaveMode(value: BasicSaveMode) {
			controls.save = value;
		},
		dispose() {
			if (disposed) return;
			disposed = true;
			owned.host.workflow.dispose();
			owned.selection.dispose();
			session.dispose();
			session.runtime.invalidate();
			scope.stop();
			textScope.dispose();
		}
	};
}

import type { AsamTagProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { SearchBase } from '../Types.js';

/** 项目示例的显示映射；保留未知值和 typed 原值，不作为通用业务字典。 */
export function projectStatusType(status: SearchBase['status']): NonNullable<AsamTagProps['type']> {
	switch (status) {
		case '进行中':
		case '处理中':
			return 'primary';
		case '已完成':
		case '启用':
		case '已发布':
		case '已审核':
			return 'success';
		case '待启动':
		case '待启用':
		case '待处理':
		case '待审核':
		case '未确定':
			return 'warning';
		case '失败':
		case '错误':
		case '拒绝':
		case '驳回':
			return 'danger';
		default:
			return 'info';
	}
}

import { computed, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import type { ComputedRef } from 'vue';
import { useAsamEditor, useAsamDetail } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type {
	AsamDetailSource,
	AsamDetailController,
	AsamEditorController,
	AsamEditorConfig,
	AsamFieldDefinition
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamDataRuntime, AsamRowKey } from '@asam-ui/ui';
export interface RecordWorkflowOptions<Row extends object> {
	runtime: AsamDataRuntime;
	fields: readonly AsamFieldDefinition[];
	key: (row: Row) => AsamRowKey;
	resolve: (key: AsamRowKey) => Row | undefined;
	context: () => string;
	allowed: (action: 'detail' | 'edit', row: Row) => boolean;
	detail: (row: Row) => AsamDetailSource;
	editor?: Omit<AsamEditorConfig, 'runtime' | 'fields' | 'canWrite'>;
	operationId: (row: Row) => string;
	create?: { allowed: () => boolean; operationId: () => string };
}
/** Shared page composition of the original editor/detail protocols, with no write state machine. */
export function useRecordWorkflow<Row extends object>(options: RecordWorkflowOptions<Row>) {
	const activeKey = shallowRef<AsamRowKey>();
	const creating = shallowRef(false);
	const detail = useAsamDetail({ runtime: options.runtime, fields: options.fields });
	const selected = computed(() =>
		activeKey.value === undefined ? undefined : options.resolve(activeKey.value)
	);
	const canEdit = computed(
		() => !!options.editor && !!selected.value && options.allowed('edit', selected.value)
	);
	const editor = options.editor
		? useAsamEditor({
				...options.editor,
				runtime: options.runtime,
				fields: options.fields,
				canWrite: () =>
					creating.value ? options.create?.allowed() === true : canEdit.value
			})
		: undefined;
	const stop = watch(
		options.context,
		() => {
			activeKey.value = undefined;
			creating.value = false;
			editor?.invalidate();
			detail.close();
		},
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	function canonical(row: Row, action: 'detail' | 'edit') {
		const current = options.resolve(options.key(row));
		return current && options.allowed(action, current) ? current : undefined;
	}
	return {
		detail,
		editor,
		canEdit,
		creating,
		async create() {
			if (!editor || !options.create?.allowed()) return;
			creating.value = true;
			activeKey.value = undefined;
			await editor.open({ mode: 'create', operationId: options.create.operationId() });
		},
		async show(row: Row) {
			const current = canonical(row, 'detail');
			if (!current) return;
			activeKey.value = options.key(current);
			await detail.open(options.detail(current));
		},
		async edit(row?: Row) {
			const current = row ? canonical(row, 'edit') : selected.value;
			if (!current || !editor || !options.allowed('edit', current)) return;
			creating.value = false;
			activeKey.value = options.key(current);
			await editor.open({
				mode: 'edit',
				id: activeKey.value,
				operationId: options.operationId(current)
			});
		},
		close() {
			detail.close();
		},
		dispose() {
			stop();
			editor?.dispose();
			detail.dispose();
			activeKey.value = undefined;
		}
	};
}
export interface RecordOverlayView {
	readonly detail: AsamDetailController;
	readonly editor?: AsamEditorController;
	readonly canEdit: ComputedRef<boolean>;
	edit(): Promise<void>;
	close(): void;
}

import { AsamDatePicker, defineAsamControl, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { AsamCrudCodec } from '@asam-ui/pro/templates/crud';
import type { AsamFieldDefinition, AsamOperationColumn } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { basicStatuses } from '../basic-list/Fields.js';
import type { BasicLabel } from '../basic-list/I18n.js';
import type { TableProject, TableQuery } from './Types.js';
export const tableInitial: TableQuery = {
	keyword: '',
	owner: undefined,
	status: undefined,
	reference: '',
	due: '',
	priority: undefined
};
const encode = (value: unknown) =>
	value === undefined ? 'all' : value === null ? 'null' : typeof value + ':' + String(value);
function decode(value: unknown): string | number | boolean | null | undefined {
	if (value === 'all' || value === undefined) return undefined;
	if (value === 'null') return null;
	if (typeof value !== 'string') throw Error('查询选项无效');
	if (value === 'number:0') return 0;
	if (value === 'boolean:false') return false;
	if (value.startsWith('string:')) return value.slice(7);
	throw Error('查询选项无效');
}
export const tableQueryCodec: AsamCrudCodec<TableQuery> = {
	encode: (q) => ({ ...q, owner: encode(q.owner), status: encode(q.status) }),
	decode: (value) => {
		const owner = decode(value.owner),
			status = decode(value.status);
		if (typeof owner === 'boolean' || typeof status === 'number')
			throw Error('查询字段类型无效');
		return {
			keyword: String(value.keyword ?? ''),
			owner,
			status,
			reference: String(value.reference ?? ''),
			due: String(value.due ?? ''),
			priority:
				typeof value.priority === 'string' && value.priority ? value.priority : undefined
		};
	}
};
export function tableQueryFields(
	t: (key: BasicLabel) => string,
	i18n: AsamI18n,
	optionLabel?: (value: unknown) => string
): readonly AsamFieldDefinition[] {
	const source = (values: readonly unknown[]) =>
		defineAsamOptions().static({
			options: values.map((value) => ({
				value: encode(value),
				get label() {
					if (optionLabel) return optionLabel(value);
					return value === undefined
						? i18n.t('app.templates.tableList.all')
						: value === null
							? i18n.t('app.templates.tableList.unknown')
							: typeof value === 'number'
								? i18n.t('app.templates.tableList.numericZero')
								: value === '0'
									? i18n.t('app.templates.tableList.stringZero')
									: String(value);
				}
			}))
		});
	return [
		{
			key: 'keyword',
			get label() {
				return t('fieldTitle');
			},
			kind: 'text'
		},
		{
			key: 'owner',
			get label() {
				return t('owner');
			},
			kind: 'single',
			source: source([undefined, '林岚', '周远', 0, '0', null])
		},
		{
			key: 'status',
			get label() {
				return t('status');
			},
			kind: 'single',
			source: source([undefined, ...basicStatuses, false, null])
		},
		{
			key: 'reference',
			get label() {
				return t('reference');
			},
			kind: 'text'
		},
		{
			key: 'due',
			get label() {
				return t('due');
			},
			kind: 'custom',
			control: defineAsamControl<unknown, object>({
				component: AsamDatePicker,
				emptyValue: () => '',
				sourceKinds: []
			}),
			isValue: (value) => value === null || typeof value === 'string',
			emptyValue: () => '',
			isEmpty: (value) => value === null || value === '',
			query: (value) => value,
			submit: (value) => value,
			format: (value) => String(value ?? ''),
			modes: { query: { componentProps: { valueFormat: 'YYYY-MM-DD', clearable: true } } }
		},
		{
			key: 'priority',
			get label() {
				return t('priority');
			},
			kind: 'single',
			source: defineAsamOptions().static({
				options: ['', '高', '中', '低'].map((value) => ({
					value,
					label:
						value || optionLabel?.(undefined) || i18n.t('app.templates.tableList.all')
				}))
			})
		}
	];
}
export function tableColumns(
	t: (key: BasicLabel) => string
): readonly AsamOperationColumn<TableProject>[] {
	return [
		{
			key: 'title',
			get label() {
				return t('fieldTitle');
			},
			width: 240,
			required: true,
			sortable: true
		},
		{
			key: 'reference',
			get label() {
				return t('reference');
			},
			width: 160
		},
		{
			key: 'owner',
			get label() {
				return t('owner');
			},
			width: 110
		},
		{

		{

			},
