import { effectScope, reactive, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamMessageBox, createAsamDataRuntime } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { extendAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import {
	createAsamWriteCoordinator,
	createAsamTableOperationCoordinator
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { useAsamCrudController } from '@asam-ui/pro/templates/crud';
import { createSearchRecords, querySearchRecords } from '../Service.js';
import { basicMessages } from '../basic-list/I18n.js';
import { basicProjectDefaults, basicStatuses, createBasicFields } from '../basic-list/Fields.js';
import {
	basicEquals,
	basicModel,
	projectFromModel,
	validateBasicModel
} from '../basic-list/Model.js';
import { tableColumns, tableInitial, tableQueryCodec, tableQueryFields } from './Fields.js';
import { tableMessages } from './I18n.js';
/** 仅本地业务数据与服务适配；全部列表、编辑、详情及删除状态由原CRUD协议持有。 */
export function createTableFixture(i18n, options = {}) {
	const textScope = extendAsamI18n(i18n, {
		'zh-CN': { ...basicMessages['zh-CN'], ...tableMessages['zh-CN'] },
		en: { ...basicMessages.en, ...tableMessages.en }
	});
	const t = (key) => textScope.t(...[`app.templates.basicList.${key}`]);
	const scope = effectScope(true),
		access = reactive({
			identity: 'table-reader-a',
			version: '1',
			disabled: false,
			readonly: false,
			permitted: true
		}),
		controls = reactive({ save: 'success', failNext: false }),
		saved = shallowRef(false),
		deleted = shallowRef(false);
	const audit = {
		reads: 0,
		saves: 0,
		commits: 0,
		verifies: 0,
		deleteSends: 0,
		deleteCommits: 0,
		deleteVerifies: 0,
		completeSends: 0,
		completeCommits: 0,
		completeVerifies: 0
	};
	const seed = createSearchRecords('basic')
		.filter((row) => row.kind === 'basic')
		.slice(0, 25)
		.map((row, index) => ({
			...row,
			...basicProjectDefaults(),
			status: index === 23 ? false : index === 24 ? null : basicStatuses[index % 4],
			team: '平台研发组',
			priority: ['高', '中', '低'][index % 3],
			startDate: '2026-10-30',
			due: index === 0 ? '' : '2026-11-30',
			progress: index === 0 ? 0 : index === 1 ? null : index % 4 === 3 ? 100 : 72,
			remind: index !== 0,
			time: index === 0 ? '00:00' : '09:00'
		}));
	const stores = new Map(),
		versions = new Map(),
		journal = new Map(),
		deleteJournal = new Set(),
		completeJournal = new Set();
	const writes = createAsamWriteCoordinator(),
		operations = createAsamTableOperationCoordinator(),
		runtime = createAsamDataRuntime({ scope: JSON.stringify(['table-list', access.identity]) });
	let sequence = 0,
		version = 1,
		disposed = false;
	const store = (owner) => {
		let rows = stores.get(owner);
		if (!rows) {
			rows = new Map(seed.map((row) => [row.id, { ...row }]));
			stores.set(owner, rows);
		}
		return rows;
	};
	const rowVersion = (owner, key) => String(versions.get(owner)?.get(key) ?? 1);
	function bump(owner, key) {
		let rows = versions.get(owner);
		if (!rows) {
			rows = new Map();
			versions.set(owner, rows);
		}
		rows.set(key, Number(rowVersion(owner, key)) + 1);
	}
	async function wait(context) {
		await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
			const end = () => {
					context?.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					resolve();
				},
				timer = setTimeout(end, 80),
				abort = () => {
					clearTimeout(timer);
					reject(new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError'));
				};
			if (context?.signal.aborted) abort();
			else context?.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
		});
	}
	function current(context, write = false) {
		if (
			disposed ||
			!runtime.isCurrent(context) ||
			access.disabled ||
			!access.permitted ||
			(write && access.readonly)
		)
			throw new DOMException('Scope unavailable', 'AbortError');
	}
	const model = (row) =>
		basicModel(row, {
			team: row.team,
			region: row.region,
			priority: row.priority,
			startDate: row.startDate,
			due: row.due,
			budget: row.budget,
			progress: row.progress,
			channels: row.channels,
			remind: row.remind,
			tags: row.tags,
			time: row.time,
			files: row.files
		});
	const defaults = () =>
		basicModel(
			{
				id: '',
				kind: 'basic',
				title: '',
				description: '',
				reference: t('autoReference'),
				category: '平台建设',
				status: '待启动',
				owner: ''
			},
			basicProjectDefaults()
		);
	async function save(value, operation, context) {
		audit.saves++;
		current(context, true);
		const key = JSON.stringify([operation.scope, operation.target.operationId]),
			known = journal.get(key);
		if (known) return known;
		const mode = controls.save;
		await wait(context);
		current(context, true);
		if (mode === 'failure') return { status: 'failure', message: t('saveDenied') };
		const data = projectFromModel(value),
			id = operation.target.id ?? 'new-' + operation.target.operationId,
			old = store(context.scope).get(id);
		if (
			!data ||
			validateBasicModel(value, t).length ||
			(operation.target.mode === 'edit' && !old)
		)
			return { status: 'failure', message: t('saveDenied') };
		const row = {
			...data,
			id,
			kind: 'basic',
			reference: old?.reference ?? 'PRJ-' + operation.target.operationId,
			title: String(value.title).trim(),
			description: String(value.description),
			category:
				typeof value.category === 'string' || typeof value.category === 'number'
					? value.category
					: null,
			status:
				typeof value.status === 'string' || typeof value.status === 'boolean'
					? value.status
					: null,
			owner:
				old && String(value.owner) === String(old.owner ?? '')
					? old.owner
					: String(value.owner),
			updatedAt: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)
		};
		if (operation.target.mode === 'create') {
			const previous = [...store(context.scope)];
			store(context.scope).clear();
			store(context.scope).set(id, row);
			for (const entry of previous) store(context.scope).set(...entry);
		} else store(context.scope).set(id, row);
		bump(context.scope, id);
		audit.commits++;
		const result = { status: 'success', data: { id } };
		journal.set(key, result);
		return mode === 'unknown-applied'
			? { status: 'unknown', message: t('saveUnknown') }
			: result;
	}
	const services = {
		async list(request, context) {
			audit.reads++;
			current(context);
			const owner = context.scope;
			await wait(context);
			current(context);
			if (controls.failNext) {
				controls.failNext = false;
				throw Error('Synthetic table-list read failed');
			}
			const q = request.query,
				rows = [...store(owner).values()].filter(
					(row) =>
						(!q.reference || row.reference.includes(q.reference)) &&
						(!q.due || row.due === q.due) &&
						(q.priority === undefined || row.priority === q.priority)
				);
			const result = querySearchRecords(rows, {
				...request,
				query: { ...q, category: undefined }
			});
			return {
				total: result.total,
				list: result.list.map((row) => {
					const canonical = store(owner).get(row.id);
					if (!canonical) throw Error('Synthetic project missing');
					return canonical;
				})
			};
		},
		async defaults(context) {
			current(context);
			return defaults();
		},
		async load(id, context) {
			await wait(context);
			current(context);
			const row = store(context.scope).get(id);
			if (!row) throw Error('Project missing');
			return model(row);
		},
		create: save,
		update: (_key, value, operation, context) => save(value, operation, context),
		async verify(operation, context) {
			audit.verifies++;
			await wait(context);
			current(context);
			const result = journal.get(
				JSON.stringify([operation.scope, operation.target.operationId])
			);
			return result?.status === 'success'
				? { status: 'success', data: result.data }
				: { status: 'unknown' };
		},
		async resolve(keys, context) {
			return keys.map((key) => {
				const row = store(context.scope).get(key);
				return row
					? {
							key,
							target: {
								key,
								version: rowVersion(context.scope, key),
								payload: { title: row.title }
							}
						}
					: { key, reason: t('deleteFailure') };
			});
		},
		async remove(target, snapshot) {
			audit.deleteSends++;
			const mode = controls.save;
			await wait();
			if (mode === 'failure')
				return { key: target.key, status: 'failure', message: t('deleteFailure') };
			const key = JSON.stringify([
				snapshot.context.scope,
				snapshot.operationId,
				typeof target.key,
				target.key
			]);
			if (!deleteJournal.has(key)) {
				store(snapshot.context.scope).delete(target.key);
				bump(snapshot.context.scope, target.key);
				deleteJournal.add(key);
				audit.deleteCommits++;
			}
			return {
				key: target.key,
				status: mode === 'unknown-applied' ? 'unknown' : 'success',
				message: mode === 'unknown-applied' ? t('deleteUnknown') : t('deleteSuccess')
			};
		},
		async verifyRemove(target, snapshot) {
			audit.deleteVerifies++;
			await wait();
			return {
				key: target.key,
				status: deleteJournal.has(
					JSON.stringify([
						snapshot.context.scope,
						snapshot.operationId,
						typeof target.key,
						target.key
					])
				)
					? 'success'
					: 'unknown'
			};
		}
	};
	const fields = createBasicFields(t),
		columns = tableColumns(t),
		queries = tableQueryFields(t, textScope);
	const preferences = new Map();
	const unresolved = () =>
		operations.records.value.some(
			(record) =>
				record.snapshot.context.scope === runtime.scope &&
				record.phase === 'settled' &&
				record.results.some(
					(result) => result.status === 'unknown' && result.dispatched !== false
				)
		);
	const crud = scope.run(() =>
		useAsamCrudController({
			runtime,
			writes,
			operations,
			rowKey: (row) => row.id,
			isKey: (value) =>
				typeof value === 'string' || (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value)),
			dataset: () => runtime.scope,
			initial: { ...tableInitial },
			queryFields: queries,
			queryCodec: tableQueryCodec,
			editFields: fields,
			detailFields: fields,
			editCodec: { encode: (value) => ({ ...value }), decode: (value) => ({ ...value }) },
			equals: basicEquals,
			validatePayload: async (value) => validateBasicModel(value, t),
			formatError: (cause) =>
				cause && typeof cause === 'object' && 'status' in cause
					? cause.status === 'unknown'
						? t('saveUnknown')
						: t('saveDenied')
					: t('operationError'),
			services,
			detail: {
				mode: 'load',
				load: async (id, context) =>
					typeof id === 'string' || typeof id === 'number'
						? { status: 'ready', data: await services.load(id, context) }
						: { status: 'missing' }
			},
			columns,
			preferences: {
				scope: () => ({
					application: 'table-list',
					principal: access.identity,
					table: 'projects',
					version: '1'
				}),
				adapter: {
					load: async (value) => preferences.get(JSON.stringify(value)) ?? null,
					save: async (value, document) => {
						preferences.set(JSON.stringify(value), structuredClone(document));
					},
					reset: async (value) => {
						preferences.delete(JSON.stringify(value));
					}
				}
			},
			pageSize: 10,
			disabled: () => access.disabled || !access.permitted,
			readonly: () => access.readonly,
			allowed: (action) =>
				!disposed &&
				!access.disabled &&
				access.permitted &&
				(action === 'detail' || (!access.readonly && !unresolved())),
			allowedRemove: (target, context) =>
				!disposed &&
				!access.disabled &&
				access.permitted &&
				!access.readonly &&
				!unresolved() &&
				context.scope === runtime.scope &&
				rowVersion(context.scope, target.key) === target.version,
			confirmDiscard: () =>
				AsamMessageBox.confirm(t('discard'), t('editTitle'), {
					confirmButtonText: t('confirm'),
					cancelButtonText: t('cancel')
				}).then(
					() => true,
					() => false
				),
			confirmRemove: (snapshot) => {
				const title =
					t('deleteConfirm') +
					' ' +
					snapshot.targets
						.map((target) =>
							target.payload &&
							typeof target.payload === 'object' &&
							!Array.isArray(target.payload) &&
							'title' in target.payload
								? String(target.payload.title)
								: String(target.key)
						)
						.join('、');
				return options.confirmDelete
					? options.confirmDelete(title)
					: AsamMessageBox.confirm(title, t('delete'), {
							type: 'warning',
							confirmButtonText: t('confirm'),
							cancelButtonText: t('cancel')
						}).then(
							() => true,
							() => false
						);
			},
			operationId: (action) => 'table-' + action + '-' + ++sequence,
			feedback: (event) => {
				if (event.kind === 'saved') saved.value = true;
				if (event.kind === 'removed') deleted.value = true;
			}
		})
	);
	const deliveredCompletions = new Set();
	const completeOperation = {
		id: 'table-complete',
		get label() {
			return textScope.t('app.templates.tableList.complete');
		},
		busyKey: 'table-complete',
		enabled: () =>
			crud.can('edit') &&
			crud.selection.ready.value &&
			!crud.editor.busy.value &&
			crud.editor.status.value !== 'unknown',
		allowed: (target, context) =>
			crud.can('edit') &&
			context.scope === runtime.scope &&
			store(context.scope).has(target.key) &&
			rowVersion(context.scope, target.key) === target.version,
		resolve: services.resolve,
		confirm: (snapshot) =>
			options.confirmComplete
				? options.confirmComplete(
						textScope.t('app.templates.tableList.complete') +
							' ' +
							snapshot.targets.length
					)
				: AsamMessageBox.confirm(
						textScope.t('app.templates.tableList.complete') +
							' ' +
							snapshot.targets.length,
						t('confirm'),
						{ confirmButtonText: t('confirm'), cancelButtonText: t('cancel') }
					).then(
						() => true,
						() => false
					),
		async execute(target, snapshot) {
			audit.completeSends++;
			const mode = controls.save;
			await wait();
			if (mode === 'failure')
				return { key: target.key, status: 'failure', message: t('saveDenied') };
			const key = JSON.stringify([
					snapshot.context.scope,
					snapshot.operationId,
					typeof target.key,
					target.key
				]),
				row = store(snapshot.context.scope).get(target.key);
			if (!completeJournal.has(key) && row) {
				store(snapshot.context.scope).set(target.key, {
					...row,
					status: '已完成',
					progress: 100
				});
				bump(snapshot.context.scope, target.key);
				completeJournal.add(key);
				audit.completeCommits++;
			}
			return {
				key: target.key,
				status: mode === 'unknown-applied' ? 'unknown' : 'success',
				message:
					mode === 'unknown-applied'
						? t('saveUnknown')
						: textScope.t('app.templates.tableList.complete')
			};
		},
		notify: (record) => {
			void settleComplete(record);
		},
		async verify(target, snapshot) {
			audit.completeVerifies++;
			await wait();
			return {
				key: target.key,
				status: completeJournal.has(
					JSON.stringify([
						snapshot.context.scope,
						snapshot.operationId,
						typeof target.key,
						target.key
					])
				)
					? 'success'
					: 'unknown'
			};
		}
	};
	async function settleComplete(record) {
		const delivery = JSON.stringify([
			record?.snapshot.operationId,
			record?.results
				.filter((result) => result.status === 'success')
				.map((result) => result.key)
		]);
		if (
			record &&
			record.phase === 'settled' &&
			!deliveredCompletions.has(delivery) &&
			record.snapshot.context.scope === runtime.scope &&
			JSON.stringify(record.snapshot.context) === JSON.stringify(crud.selection.context()) &&
			record.results.length &&
			record.results.some((result) => result.status === 'success')
		) {
			deliveredCompletions.add(delivery);
			await crud.list.refresh();
			if (record.results.every((result) => result.status === 'success'))
				crud.selection.clear();
		}
		return record;
	}
	async function complete() {
		return settleComplete(
			await operations.run(
				completeOperation,
				'table-complete-' + ++sequence,
				crud.selection.keys.value,
				crud.selection
			)
		);
	}
	async function verifyComplete(id) {
		if (disposed || access.disabled || !access.permitted) return;
		if (
			operations.records.value.find((record) => record.snapshot.operationId === id)?.snapshot
				.context.scope !== runtime.scope
		)
			return;
		return settleComplete(await operations.verify(id));
	}
	async function retryComplete(id) {
		return settleComplete(await operations.retry(id, crud.selection));
	}
	async function rebind() {
		saved.value = deleted.value = false;
		access.version = String(++version);
		const owner = JSON.stringify(['table-list', access.identity]);
		if (runtime.scope === owner) runtime.invalidate();
		else runtime.setScope(owner);
		crud.list.resumeScope(tableQueryCodec.encode(tableInitial));
		if (!access.disabled && access.permitted) await crud.list.submit();
	}
	return {
		crud,
		fields,
		columns,
		queries,
		operations,
		completeOperation,
		complete,
		verifyComplete,
		retryComplete,
		runtime,
		access,
		controls,
		saved,
		deleted,
		audit,
		async initialize() {
			if (!crud.list.resultReady.value) await crud.list.submit();
		},
		async toggleReadonly() {
			access.readonly = !access.readonly;
		},
		async toggleDisabled() {
			access.disabled = !access.disabled;
			await rebind();
		},
		async toggleDenied() {
			access.permitted = !access.permitted;
			await rebind();
		},
		async identity() {
			access.identity =
				access.identity === 'table-reader-a' ? 'table-reader-b' : 'table-reader-a';
			await rebind();
		},
		failNext() {
			controls.failNext = true;
		},
		setSaveMode(value) {
			controls.save = value;
		},
		dispose() {
			if (disposed) return;
			disposed = true;
			crud.dispose();
			runtime.invalidate();
			scope.stop();
			textScope.dispose();
		}
	};
}

};

	'app.templates.tableList.eyebrow': 'Keep every project moving',
	'app.templates.tableList.query': 'Project search',
	'app.templates.tableList.data': 'Team projects',
	'app.templates.tableList.all': 'All',

import { createSearchQueryController } from '../QueryController.js';
import { tableQueryCodec, tableQueryFields } from './Fields.js';
export function createTableSearchQueryController(
	session,
	t,
	i18n,
	fields = (fields) => fields,
	optionLabel
) {
	return createSearchQueryController(session, {
		fields: () => fields(tableQueryFields(t, i18n, optionLabel)),
		encode(draft) {
			const { owner, status, priority } = draft;
			return {
				...draft,
				...tableQueryCodec.encode({
					keyword: String(draft.keyword ?? ''),
					owner:
						typeof owner === 'string' || typeof owner === 'number' || owner === null
							? owner
							: undefined,
					status:
						typeof status === 'string' || typeof status === 'boolean' || status === null
							? status
							: undefined,
					reference: String(draft.reference ?? ''),
					due: String(draft.due ?? ''),
					priority: typeof priority === 'string' ? priority : ''
				})
			};
		},
		decode(draft) {
			return {
				...session.controller.draft.value,
				...tableQueryCodec.decode({
					...draft,
					owner: draft.owner ?? 'all',
					status: draft.status ?? 'all'
				})
			};
		}
	});
}

<template>
	<main class="table-list-page">
		<AsamCrudPage
			:controller="crud"
			presentation="query-table"
			:title="i18n.t('app.templates.tableList.title')"
			:query-field-labels="queryLabels"
			:detail-entry="false"
			:size="size"
			:content-width="websiteCrudWidth"
			@update:content-width="websiteSetCrudWidth"
			><template #heading
				><p class="table-list-eyebrow">
					{{ i18n.t('app.templates.tableList.eyebrow') }}
				</p></template
			><template #toolbar
				><AsamButton
					type="primary"
					plain
					:size="size"
					:disabled="!canComplete"
					@click="fixture.complete()"
					>{{ fixture.completeOperation.label }}</AsamButton
				><span>{{
					i18n.t('app.templates.tableList.selected', {
						count: crud.selection.keys.value.length
					})
				}}</span></template
			><template #cell="{ row, column }"
				><AsamTag v-if="column.key === 'status'" :type="projectStatusType(row.status)">{{
					displayValue(row.status, scope)
				}}</AsamTag
				><AsamProgress
					v-else-if="column.key === 'progress' && row.progress !== null"
					:percentage="row.progress"
				/><span v-else-if="column.key === 'progress'">{{
					displayProgress(row.progress, scope)
				}}</span
				><span v-else>{{ displayValue(row[column.key], scope) }}</span></template
			><template #default
				><div
					v-for="record in completionRecords"
					:key="record.snapshot.operationId"
					class="table-operation-feedback"
					role="status"
				>
					<p>{{ completionMessage(record) }}</p>
					<AsamButton
						v-if="hasUnknown(record)"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="crud.disabled.value || !!crud.operations.busy.value.length"
						@click="fixture.verifyComplete(record.snapshot.operationId)"
						type="primary"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.tableList.verifyOriginal') }}</AsamButton
					><AsamButton
						v-else-if="hasRetryable(record)"
						:size="size"
						:disabled="!crud.can('edit') || !!crud.operations.busy.value.length"
						@click="fixture.retryComplete(record.snapshot.operationId)"
						type="primary"
						>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.tableList.retryOriginal') }}</AsamButton
					>
				</div></template
			></AsamCrudPage
		>
	</main>
</template>
<script setup>
import { computed as websiteComputed, inject as websiteInject } from 'vue';
const websiteFullWidth = websiteInject(Symbol.for('asam.website.preview.fullWidth'), null);
const websiteCrudWidth = websiteComputed(() =>
	websiteFullWidth ? (websiteFullWidth.value ? 'full' : 'contained') : undefined
);
function websiteSetCrudWidth(width) {
	if (websiteFullWidth) websiteFullWidth.value = width === 'full';
}
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamTag, AsamProgress } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamCrudPage } from '@asam-ui/pro/templates/crud';
import { useBasicText } from '../basic-list/I18n.js';
import { displayValue, displayProgress } from '../Content.js';

import { createApp, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamI18nKey, createAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import App from './App.vue';
import { createTableFixture } from './Fixture.js';
export async function mountTableList(element, host, onError) {
	const locale = shallowRef('zh-CN');
	const i18n = host?.i18n ?? createAsamI18n(() => ({ locale: locale.value }));
	const fixture = createTableFixture(i18n);
	const app = createApp(App, {
		fixture,
		externalI18n: host?.i18n,
		inheritAppearance: host?.inheritAppearance,
		onLocale: (value) => {
			locale.value = value;
		}
	});
	app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
	if (host?.fullWidth) app.provide(Symbol.for('asam.website.preview.fullWidth'), host.fullWidth);
	provideAsamData(app, {}, { scope: 'table-list-demo' });
	if (onError) app.config.errorHandler = onError;
	try {
		await fixture.initialize();
		app.mount(element);
	} catch (error) {
		fixture.dispose();
		if (!host?.i18n) i18n.dispose();
		throw error;
	}
	let disposed = false;
	return () => {
		if (disposed) return;
		disposed = true;
		app.unmount();
		fixture.dispose();
		if (!host?.i18n) i18n.dispose();
	};
}

<template>
	<div class="template-list-toolbar" role="toolbar" :aria-label="label">
		<div class="template-list-toolbar-start">
			<AsamButton
				v-if="createLabel"
				type="primary"
				:size="size"
				:icon="Plus"
				:disabled="createDisabled"
				@click="emit('create')"
				>{{ createLabel }}</AsamButton
			><span v-if="summary" class="template-list-toolbar-summary" role="status">{{
				summary
			}}</span>
		</div>
		<div v-if="actions.length" class="template-list-toolbar-tools">
			<AsamButton
				v-for="tool in actions"
				:key="tool.id"
				class="template-list-toolbar-icon"
				type="primary"
				:text="!tool.pressed"
				:size="size"
				:icon="tool.icon"
				:disabled="tool.disabled"
				:aria-disabled="tool.ariaDisabled || undefined"
				:aria-pressed="tool.pressed"
				:aria-label="tool.label"
				:title="tool.label"
				:data-state="tool.state"
				@click="activate(tool)"
			/>
		</div>
	</div>
</template>
<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useAsamProI18n } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { FullScreen, Grid, List, Plus, ScaleToOriginal } from '@asam-ui/icons-vue';
const props = defineProps({
	label: { type: String, required: true },
	summary: { type: String, required: false },
	size: { type: String, required: false },
	createLabel: { type: String, required: false },
	createDisabled: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	tools: { type: Array, required: false },
	viewDisabled: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	wide: { type: Boolean, required: false, default: undefined },
	layout: { type: String, required: false }
});
const emit = defineEmits(['create', 'action', 'update:wide', 'update:layout']);
const i18n = useAsamProI18n();
const labels = computed(() =>
	i18n.locale.value.startsWith('en')
		? {
				shrink: 'Use constrained width',
				widen: 'Use full width',
				horizontal: 'Switch to horizontal layout',
				vertical: 'Switch to vertical layout'
			}
		: {
				shrink: '切为窄版',
				widen: '铺满内容区',
				horizontal: '切为横向排列',
				vertical: '切为纵向排列'
			}
);
const actions = computed(() => {
	const items = [...(props.tools ?? [])];
	if (props.wide !== undefined) {
		items.push({
			id: 'width',
			label: props.wide ? labels.value.shrink : labels.value.widen,
			icon: props.wide ? ScaleToOriginal : FullScreen,
			disabled: props.viewDisabled,
			pressed: props.wide
		});
	}
	if (props.layout) {
		const vertical = props.layout === 'list';
		items.push({
			id: 'layout',
			label: vertical ? labels.value.horizontal : labels.value.vertical,
			icon: vertical ? Grid : List,
			disabled: props.viewDisabled,
			pressed: vertical
		});
	}
	return items;
});
function activate(tool) {
	if (tool.disabled || tool.ariaDisabled) return;
	if (tool.id === 'width' && props.wide !== undefined) emit('update:wide', !props.wide);
	else if (tool.id === 'layout' && props.layout)
		emit('update:layout', props.layout === 'list' ? 'grid' : 'list');
	else emit('action', tool.id);
}
</script>

export {};

查询表格使用原BasicRecord与前端项目扩展、原列表控制器和明确的本地项目扩展。六项查询条件同时作用于整个数据集；查询、重置、排序和分页沿原控制器，不在当前页伪筛选。

同源项目管理

完整十八字段的编辑表单使用 AsamFormDialog，详情使用 CRUD 的 AsamDetailDrawer。新增、编辑、详情读取同一本地数据集；删除使用原跨页选择与操作协调器，确认后复核上下文。结果未知只核实原operationId，不自动重发。只读、禁用、权限、身份和查询变化均按原作用域隔离。

接入边界

项目进度和计划、协作、附件字段由页面宿主显式提供，未新增后台DTO/API。0、false、空数组、00:00和未知值保留；进度未知不显示为0。附件仅本地模拟，不发送邮件、短信或上传服务器。分页采用原控制器合法的10/20/50/100，不伪装支持5。JS checkJs=false、strictTemplates=true、skipLibCheck=false。
